/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_ETrans_Qty_DET]    Script Date: 12-08-2023 17:26:35 ******/

GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_ETrans_Qty_DET]
AS
SELECT        dbo.tblOpStk.EntryDate, dbo.tblOpStk.ItemId, Sum(dbo.tblOpStk.Stk) AS OPQty, Sum(dbo.tblOpStk.Stk*dbo.tblOpStk.pRate) AS OPAmt, 
                         0 as PQty,0 as PAmt,0 AS SQTY, 0 AS SAmt, 0 PRQty, 0 AS PRAmt, 0 SRQty, 0 AS SRAmt, dbo.tblOpStk .BranchId, 1 AS EType
FROM            dbo.tblOpStk 
GROUP BY dbo.tblOpStk .EntryDate, dbo.tblOpStk .ItemId, tblOpStk .BranchId
UNION ALL
SELECT        dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.EntryDate, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.ItemId,0 as OPQty,0 as OPAmt, Sum(dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.Quantity) AS PQty, Sum(dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.Amount) AS PAmt, 
                         0 AS SQTY, 0 AS SAmt, 0 PRQty, 0 AS PRAmt, 0 SRQty, 0 AS SRAmt, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.BranchId, 2 AS EType
FROM            dbo.tblPurchaseMaster INNER JOIN
                         dbo.tblPurchaseDetails ON dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.PurchaseMasterId = dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.PurchaseMasterId
GROUP BY dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.EntryDate, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.ItemId, tblPurchaseMaster.BranchId
UNION ALL
SELECT        dbo.tblSalesMaster.EntryDate, dbo.tblSalesDetails.ItemId, 0 as OPQty,0 as OPAmt,0 AS PQTY, 0 AS PAmt, Sum(dbo.tblSalesDetails.Quantity) AS SQty, Sum(dbo.tblSalesDetails.Amount) 
                         AS SAmt, 0 PRQty, 0 AS PRAmt, 0 SRQty, 0 AS SRAmt, dbo.tblSalesMaster.BranchId, 3 AS EType
FROM            dbo.tblSalesMaster INNER JOIN
                         dbo.tblSalesDetails ON dbo.tblSalesMaster.SalesMasterId = dbo.tblSalesDetails.SalesMasterId
GROUP BY dbo.tblSalesMaster.EntryDate, dbo.tblSalesDetails.ItemId, tblSalesMaster.BranchId
UNION
SELECT        dbo.tblPurchaseReturnMaster.EntryDate, dbo.tblPurchaseReturnDetails.ItemId, 0 as OPQty,0 as OPAmt,0 AS PQTY, 0 AS PAmt, 0 AS SQTY, 0 AS SAmt, 
                         Sum(dbo.tblPurchaseReturnDetails.Quantity) AS PRQty, Sum(dbo.tblPurchaseReturnDetails.Amount) AS PRAmt, 0 SRQty, 0 AS SRAmt, 
                         dbo.tblPurchaseReturnMaster.BranchId, 4 AS EType
FROM            dbo.tblPurchaseReturnMaster INNER JOIN
                         dbo.tblPurchaseReturnDetails ON dbo.tblPurchaseReturnMaster.PurchaseReturnMasterId = dbo.tblPurchaseReturnDetails.PurchaseReturnMasterId
GROUP BY dbo.tblPurchaseReturnMaster.EntryDate, dbo.tblPurchaseReturnDetails.ItemId, tblPurchaseReturnMaster.BranchId
UNION
SELECT        dbo.tblSalesReturnMaster.EntryDate AS EntryDate, dbo.tblSalesReturnDetails.ItemId AS ItemId, 0 as OPQty,0 as OPAmt,0 AS PQTY, 0 AS PAmt, 0 AS SQTY, 0 AS SAmt, 0 PRQty, 0 AS PRAmt, 
                         Sum(dbo.tblSalesReturnDetails.Quantity) AS SRQty, Sum(dbo.tblSalesReturnDetails.Amount) AS SRAmt, dbo.tblSalesReturnMaster.BranchId, 5 AS EType
FROM            dbo.tblSalesReturnMaster INNER JOIN
                         dbo.tblSalesReturnDetails ON dbo.tblSalesReturnMaster.SalesReturnMasterId = dbo.tblSalesReturnDetails.SalesReturnMasterId
GROUP BY dbo.tblSalesReturnMaster.EntryDate, dbo.tblSalesReturnDetails.ItemId, tblSalesReturnMaster.BranchId
GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_ETransDet_Qty_Tot]    Script Date: 12-08-2023 17:26:35 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_ETransDet_Qty_Tot]
AS
SELECT        EntryDate, ItemId, SUM(OPQty) AS OPQty, SUM(OPAmt) AS OPAmt, SUM(PQty) AS PQty, SUM(PAmt) AS PAmt, SUM(SQTY) AS SQTY, SUM(SAmt) AS SAmt, SUM(PRQty) 
                         AS PRQty, SUM(PRAmt) AS PRAmt, SUM(SRQty) AS SRQty, SUM(SRAmt) AS SRAmt, BranchId
FROM            dbo.vw_ETrans_Qty_DET
GROUP BY EntryDate, ItemId, BranchId
GO

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_Trial_BS]
AS
SELECT        dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.AccountGroupName AS sFld1, (SUM(dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.DrAmt) - SUM(dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.CrAmt)) AS nfld1, 
                         0 AS nFld2, dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.BranchId, dbo.tblCompany.CompanyName, dbo.tblBranch.BranchName, dbo.tblBranch.BranchAddress, 
                         dbo.tblBranch.Telephone, dbo.tblBranch.Email, dbo.tblBranch.Website, dbo.tblBranch.GSTNo, dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.EntryDate 
FROM            dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet INNER JOIN
                         dbo.tblBranch ON dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.BranchId = dbo.tblBranch.BranchId INNER JOIN
                         dbo.tblCompany ON dbo.tblBranch.CompanyId = dbo.tblCompany.CompanyId
WHERE        (dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.TrnType = '2' OR
                         dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.TrnType = '3') AND (dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.AccountGroupid = 20) AND dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.LedgerId <> 155
GROUP BY dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.AccountGroupName, dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.BranchId, dbo.tblCompany.CompanyName, dbo.tblBranch.BranchName, 
                         dbo.tblBranch.BranchAddress, dbo.tblBranch.Telephone, dbo.tblBranch.Email, dbo.tblBranch.Website, dbo.tblBranch.GSTNo, 
                         dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.EntryDate
UNION ALL
SELECT        dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.AccountGroupName AS sFld1, 0 AS nFld1, (SUM(dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.CrAmt) - SUM(dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.DrAmt)) 
                         AS nfld2, dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.BranchId, dbo.tblCompany.CompanyName, dbo.tblBranch.BranchName, dbo.tblBranch.BranchAddress, 
                         dbo.tblBranch.Telephone, dbo.tblBranch.Email, dbo.tblBranch.Website, dbo.tblBranch.GSTNo, dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.EntryDate FROM            dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet INNER JOIN
                         dbo.tblBranch ON dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.BranchId = dbo.tblBranch.BranchId INNER JOIN
                         dbo.tblCompany ON dbo.tblBranch.CompanyId = dbo.tblCompany.CompanyId
WHERE        (dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.TrnType = '1' OR
                         dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.TrnType = '4') AND (dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.AccountGroupid = 19)
GROUP BY dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.AccountGroupName, dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.BranchId, dbo.tblCompany.CompanyName, dbo.tblBranch.BranchName, 
                         dbo.tblBranch.BranchAddress, dbo.tblBranch.Telephone, dbo.tblBranch.Email, dbo.tblBranch.Website, dbo.tblBranch.GSTNo, 
                         dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.EntryDate 
UNION ALL

                         0 AS nFld2, dbo.vw_AccLed_Cash_TransEntDet.BranchId, dbo.tblCompany.CompanyName, dbo.tblBranch.BranchName, dbo.tblBranch.BranchAddress,

GROUP BY MainGrp, dbo.vw_AccLed_TransEntDet.BranchId, TrnType, dbo.tblCompany.CompanyName, dbo.tblBranch.BranchName, dbo.tblBranch.BranchAddress,

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_ETrans_DtwiseTot_NetAmt_Qty_Det]    Script Date: 12-08-2023 17:26:36 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_ETrans_DtwiseTot_NetAmt_Qty_Det]
AS
SELECT        mst.EntryDate, (SELECT Sum(dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.NetAmount) AS SumOfNetAmount
FROM dbo.tblPurchaseMaster
where mst.EntryDate=dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.EntryDate ) AS PNet_Amt, Sum(dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.Quantity) AS PQty, 0 AS SNet_Amt, 0 AS SQty, 
0 AS PRNet_Amt, 0 AS PRQty, 0 AS SRNet_Amt, 0 AS SRQty, 0 AS InwNet_Amt, 0 AS InwQty, 0 AS OutNet_Amt, 0 AS OutQty, mst.BranchId, 
2 AS EType
FROM dbo.tblPurchaseMaster Mst INNER JOIN
dbo.tblPurchaseDetails ON mst.PurchaseMasterId = dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.PurchaseMasterId
GROUP BY mst.EntryDate, mst.BranchId
UNION ALL
SELECT        Mst.EntryDate, 0 AS PNet_Amt, 0 AS PQty, (SELECT Sum(dbo.tblSalesMaster.NetAmount) AS SumOfNetAmount
FROM dbo.tblSalesMaster
where mst.EntryDate=dbo.tblSalesMaster.EntryDate) AS SNet_Amt, Sum(dbo.tblSalesDetails.Quantity) AS SQty, 
0 AS PRNet_Amt, 0 AS PRQty, 0 AS SRNet_Amt, 0 AS SRQty, 0 AS InwNet_Amt, 0 AS InwQty, 0 AS OutNet_Amt, 0 AS OutQty, Mst.BranchId, 
3 AS EType
FROM dbo.tblSalesMaster Mst INNER JOIN
                         dbo.tblSalesDetails ON Mst.SalesMasterId = dbo.tblSalesDetails.SalesMasterId
GROUP BY Mst.EntryDate, Mst.BranchId
UNION ALL
SELECT        Mst.EntryDate, 0 AS PNet_Amt, 0 AS PQty, 0 AS SNet_Amt, 0 AS SQty, (SELECT Sum(dbo.tblPurchaseReturnMaster.NetAmount) AS SumOfNetAmount
FROM dbo.tblPurchaseReturnMaster
where mst.EntryDate=dbo.tblPurchaseReturnMaster.EntryDate ) AS PRNet_Amt, 
                         Sum(dbo.tblPurchaseReturnDetails.Quantity) AS PRQty, 0 AS SRNet_Amt, 0 AS SRQty, 0 AS InwNet_Amt, 0 AS InwQty, 0 AS OutNet_Amt, 0 AS OutQty, 
                         Mst.BranchId, 4 AS EType
FROM            dbo.tblPurchaseReturnMaster Mst INNER JOIN
                         dbo.tblPurchaseReturnDetails ON Mst.PurchaseReturnMasterId = dbo.tblPurchaseReturnDetails.PurchaseReturnMasterId
GROUP BY Mst.EntryDate, Mst.BranchId
UNION ALL
SELECT        Mst.EntryDate, 0 AS PNet_Amt, 0 AS PQty, 0 AS SNet_Amt, 0 AS SQty, 0 AS PRNet_Amt, 0 AS PRQty, 
                         (SELECT Sum(dbo.tblSalesReturnMaster.NetAmount) AS SumOfNetAmount
FROM dbo.tblSalesReturnMaster
where mst.EntryDate=dbo.tblSalesReturnMaster.EntryDate ) AS SRNet_Amt, Sum(dbo.tblSalesReturnDetails.Quantity) AS SRQty, 0 AS InwNet_Amt, 0 AS InwQty, 0 AS OutNet_Amt, 
                         0 AS OutQty, Mst.BranchId, 5 AS EType
FROM            dbo.tblSalesReturnMaster Mst INNER JOIN
                         dbo.tblSalesReturnDetails ON Mst.SalesReturnMasterId = dbo.tblSalesReturnDetails.SalesReturnMasterId
GROUP BY Mst.EntryDate, Mst.BranchId
UNION ALL

SELECT        Mst.EntryDate, 0 AS PNet_Amt, 0 AS PQty, 0 AS SNet_Amt, 0 AS SQty, 0 AS PRNet_Amt, 0 AS PRQty, 0 AS SRNet_Amt, 0 AS SRQty, 
                         (SELECT Sum(dbo.tblInward.NetAmount) AS SumOfNetAmount
FROM dbo.tblInward
where mst.EntryDate=dbo.tblInward.EntryDate ) AS InwNet_Amt, Sum(dbo.tblInwDetails.Quantity) AS InwQty, 0 AS OutNet_Amt, 0 AS OutQty, Mst.BranchId, 6 AS EType
FROM            dbo.tblInward Mst INNER JOIN
                         dbo.tblInwDetails ON Mst.InwardMasterId = dbo.tblInwDetails.InwardMasterId
GROUP BY Mst.EntryDate, Mst.BranchId
UNION ALL
SELECT        Mst.EntryDate, 0 AS PNet_Amt, 0 AS PQty, 0 AS SNet_Amt, 0 AS SQty, 0 AS PRNet_Amt, 0 AS PRQty, 0 AS SRNet_Amt, 0 AS SRQty, 0 AS InwNet_Amt, 
                         0 AS InwQty, (SELECT Sum(dbo.tblOutward.NetAmount) AS SumOfNetAmount
FROM dbo.tblOutward
where mst.EntryDate=dbo.tblOutward.EntryDate ) AS OutNet_Amt, Sum(dbo.tblOutwardDetails.Quantity) AS OutQty, Mst.BranchId, 8 AS EType
FROM            dbo.tblOutward Mst INNER JOIN
                         dbo.tblOutwardDetails ON Mst.OutwardId = dbo.tblOutwardDetails.OutwardId
GROUP BY Mst.EntryDate, Mst.BranchId;
GO

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_SaleGST]    Script Date: 12-08-2023 17:26:36 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_SaleGST]
AS
SELECT        dbo.tblSalesMaster.EntryDate, SUM(dbo.tblSalesDetails.NetAmount) AS S_NetAmount1, dbo.tblSalesMaster.BranchId, Q_TaxType.GTypeSubValue1 AS TaxTypeVal, 
                         Q_MnEnoMxEno.MnEno, Q_MnEnoMxEno.MxEno, SUM(dbo.tblSalesDetails.Quantity) AS S_Quantity, 
                         SUM(ROUND(dbo.tblSalesDetails.NetAmount - (dbo.tblSalesDetails.NetAmount * 100) / (ISNULL(Q_TaxType.GTypeSubValue1, 0) + 100), 2)) AS IGST, 
                         SUM(ROUND(dbo.tblSalesDetails.NetAmount - (dbo.tblSalesDetails.NetAmount * 100) / (ISNULL(Q_TaxType.GTypeSubValue1, 0) + 100), 2) / 2) AS CGST, 
                         SUM(ROUND(dbo.tblSalesDetails.NetAmount - (dbo.tblSalesDetails.NetAmount * 100) / (ISNULL(Q_TaxType.GTypeSubValue1, 0) + 100), 2) / 2) AS sGST, 
                         Q_TaxType.Caption AS TaxType, dbo.tblCompany.CompanyName, dbo.tblBranch.BranchName, dbo.tblBranch.BranchAddress, dbo.tblBranch.Telephone, 
                         dbo.tblBranch.Mobile, dbo.tblBranch.Email, dbo.tblBranch.Website, dbo.tblBranch.GSTNo
FROM            dbo.tblSalesMaster INNER JOIN
                         dbo.tblSalesDetails ON dbo.tblSalesMaster.SalesMasterId = dbo.tblSalesDetails.SalesMasterId INNER JOIN
                             (SELECT        tblSalesMaster_1.EntryDate, tblSalesDetails_1.TaxType, MIN(tblSalesMaster_1.EntryNo) AS MnEno, MAX(tblSalesMaster_1.EntryNo) AS MxEno, 
                                                         SUM(tblSalesDetails_1.NetAmount) AS S_NetAmount, SUM(tblSalesDetails_1.IGSTAmount) AS S_IGSTAmount, tblSalesMaster_1.BranchId
                               FROM            dbo.tblSalesMaster AS tblSalesMaster_1 INNER JOIN
                                                         dbo.tblSalesDetails AS tblSalesDetails_1 ON tblSalesMaster_1.SalesMasterId = tblSalesDetails_1.SalesMasterId
                               WHERE        (tblSalesDetails_1.Quantity <> 0) AND (tblSalesDetails_1.ItemId > 0) AND (tblSalesDetails_1.NetAmount > 0)
                               GROUP BY tblSalesMaster_1.EntryDate, tblSalesDetails_1.TaxType, tblSalesMaster_1.BranchId) AS Q_MnEnoMxEno ON 
                         dbo.tblSalesDetails.BranchId = Q_MnEnoMxEno.BranchId AND dbo.tblSalesDetails.TaxType = Q_MnEnoMxEno.TaxType AND 
                         dbo.tblSalesMaster.EntryDate = Q_MnEnoMxEno.EntryDate INNER JOIN
                         dbo.tblBranch ON dbo.tblSalesMaster.BranchId = dbo.tblBranch.BranchId INNER JOIN
                         dbo.tblCompany ON dbo.tblBranch.CompanyId = dbo.tblCompany.CompanyId LEFT OUTER JOIN
                             (SELECT        Caption, GeneralId, GTypeSubValue1
                               FROM            dbo.tblGeneralOptions
                               WHERE        (GTypeId = 1)) AS Q_TaxType ON dbo.tblSalesDetails.TaxType = Q_TaxType.GeneralId
GROUP BY dbo.tblSalesMaster.EntryDate, Q_TaxType.GTypeSubValue1, Q_MnEnoMxEno.MnEno, Q_MnEnoMxEno.MxEno, dbo.tblSalesMaster.BranchId, Q_TaxType.Caption, 
                         dbo.tblCompany.CompanyName, dbo.tblBranch.BranchName, dbo.tblBranch.BranchAddress, dbo.tblBranch.Telephone, dbo.tblBranch.Mobile, dbo.tblBranch.Email, 
                         dbo.tblBranch.Website, dbo.tblBranch.GSTNo
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[prd_Export_PurchaseEntrytoOutward]    Script Date: 12-08-2023 17:26:38 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prd_Export_PurchaseEntrytoOutward]
@PurchID bigint,
@OutToiD int,
@CreatedBy int,
@BranchId int
AS
BEGIN 
 SET NOCOUNT ON;   
  BEGIN TRANSACTION                                                       
	BEGIN          
			Declare @Id bigint
			DECLARE @Serial TABLE( OutwardSrlNo BIGINT )

			UPDATE tblBranch SET OutwardSrlNo=OutwardSrlNo+1 
			OUTPUT inserted.OutwardSrlNo INTO @Serial 
			where BranchId=@BranchId

			

			INSERT INTO dbo.tblOutward ( EType, EntryNo, EntryDate, DocumentNo, LedgerId, PaymentMode, Telephone, Remarks, TotalGross, TotalAmount, TotalDiscount, TotalTax, TotalCess, TotalIGST, TotalCGST, TotalSGST, TotalMiscCharges, DiscountPer, DiscountAmount, AmountAdjust, NetAmount, TransportNo, CreditDays, DueDate, DocumentType, BranchId, FinancialYearId, TotalQuantity, DocumentDate, TotalNetAmount, CreatedBy, CreatedDateTime, Status ,Toid)
			SELECT dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.EType, (select OutwardSrlNo FROM @Serial), (SELECT convert(varchar(10), Convert(date,SYSDATEtime(),105), 23)), concat(dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.EntryNo,'/',isnull(dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.DocumentNo,'')), dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.LedgerId, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.PaymentMode, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.Telephone, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.Remarks, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.TotalGross, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.TotalAmount, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.TotalDiscount, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.TotalTax, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.TotalCess, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.TotalIGST, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.TotalCGST, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.TotalSGST, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.TotalMiscCharges, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.DiscountPer, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.DiscountAmount, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.AmountAdjust, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.NetAmount, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.TransportNo, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.CreditDays, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.DueDate, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.DocumentType, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.BranchId, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.FinancialYearId, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.TotalQuantity, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.DocumentDate, dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.TotalNetAmount, @CreatedBy, SYSDATETIME() , dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.Status, @OutToiD
			FROM dbo.tblPurchaseMaster
			WHERE dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.PurchaseMasterId=@PurchID 

			Set @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY()
			select @Id as OutwardId

			INSERT INTO dbo.tblOutwardDetails ( ItemId, ItemCode, ItemBarCode, UnitId, Quantity, FreeQuantity, PurchaseRate, IRate, Amount, DiscountPer, DiscountAmount, IGSTAmount, CGSTAmount, SGSTAmount, GrossAmount, TaxPer, TaxAmount, CessPer, CessAmount, NetAmount, BranchId, FinancialYearId, TaxType, Cost, Margin, MRP, Status, CreatedBy, CreatedDateTime, OutwardId)
			SELECT dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.ItemId, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.ItemCode, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.ItemBarCode, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.UnitId, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.Quantity, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.FreeQuantity, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.PurchaseRate, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.IRate, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.Amount, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.DiscountPer, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.DiscountAmount, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.IGSTAmount, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.CGSTAmount, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.SGSTAmount, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.GrossAmount, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.TaxPer, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.TaxAmount, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.CessPer, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.CessAmount, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.NetAmount, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.BranchId, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.FinancialYearId, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.TaxType, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.Cost, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.Margin, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.MRP, dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.Status, @CreatedBy, SYSDATETIME(), @id
			FROM dbo.tblPurchaseDetails
			WHERE dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.PurchaseMasterId=@PurchID 

			IF(@@ERROR <> 0)                                                       
			 GOTO  QUITWITHROLLBACK                                                       
			ELSE      
			 GOTO ENDSAVE      

 END     
     
 QUITWITHROLLBACK:                                                      
 IF (@@TRANCOUNT > 0)                                                       
 BEGIN                                                                                   
 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION                                                      
 END                                                          
     

 ENDSAVE:                                                       
 IF (@@TRANCOUNT > 0)                                                      
 BEGIN                                                      
 COMMIT TRANSACTION                                                      
 END       
      
END


GO

GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdClearCardDetails]
@LedgerId int,
	@CardNo nvarchar(50),
	@BranchId int,
	@CreatedBy int,
	@ModifiedBy int,
	@Status int
AS
declare @Id int;
BEGIN
	
	
	if (@LedgerId >0)
	begin
	
	Insert into tblClearCard ([LedgerId], [ICardNo],[BranchId],[CreatedBy],[CreatedDateTime],[Status])values
(@LedgerId,@CardNo,@BranchId,@CreatedBy,SYSDATETIME(),@Status);
  Set @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY()
INSERT INTO tblOldCardHistory ([EntryDate],[Etype],[LedgerId],[ICardNo],[Balance],[Amount],[CardBalance],[gNotes],[payid],[payid_adate],[BranchId]
      ,[CreatedBy],[CreatedDateTime],[ModifiedBy],[ModifiedDateTime],[Status],[mDevice],[mDeviceIP],[Debit],[GameId],[Duration],[EstOutTime]
      ,[Rating],[Tax],[TaxSettingsId],[TaxAmt],ClearCardId) 
	  SELECT [EntryDate],[Etype],[LedgerId],[ICardNo],[Balance],[Amount],[CurrentBalance],[gNotes],[payid],[payid_adate],[BranchId]
      ,[CreatedBy],[CreatedDateTime],[ModifiedBy],[ModifiedDateTime],[Status],[mDevice],[mDeviceIP],[Debit],[MasterId],[Duration],[EstOutTime]
      ,[Rating],[Tax],[TaxSettingsId],[TaxAmt],@Id FROM tblCardHistory WHERE ICardNo=@CardNo;

update tblAccountLedger set ICardNo='',ModifiedBy=@CreatedBy,ModifiedDateTime=SYSDATETIME() where ICardNo=@CardNo;

Delete tblCardHistory WHERE ICardNo=@CardNo; 

	end
	

END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdComboFillCountry]

@Caption nvarchar(50),
@GTypeId int
AS
BEGIN
declare @count int;
declare @max int;
set @count=(select COUNT(*) from tblGeneralOptions where Caption = @Caption);
if @count =0
begin
set @max=(select max(GTypeSubId) from tblGeneralOptions where GTypeId = @GTypeId);
set @max=@max+1;
insert into tblGeneralOptions (Caption,GTypeId,GTypeSubId)values(@Caption,@GTypeId,@max);
end

END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[PrdDuration]    Script Date: 12-08-2023 17:26:38 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PrdDuration]
@LedgerId int
AS
BEGIN
SELECT DATEDIFF(MINUTE,(select TOP 1 EntryDate  from tblCardHistory where LedgerId=@LedgerId and Etype=1
	and CONVERT(char(10), EntryDate,126) =  FORMAT(getdate(),'yyyy-MM-dd ')  ORDER BY EntryDate DESC),(FORMAT(getdate(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss '))) AS Duration;

END
GO

CREATE procedure [dbo].[prdFillUnit]

 @ItemId bigint
 As Begin

SELECT * FROM  (select U.UnitId ,U.UnitName,1 AS UnitOrder from tblUnit U inner join tblItem I on U.UnitId=I.MainUnitId where I.ItemId=@ItemId 
union
select U.UnitId ,U.UnitName, 2 AS UnitOrder  from tblUnit U inner join tblItem I on U.UnitId=I.SubUnitId  where I.ItemId=@ItemId) as UnitTable ORDER BY UnitTable.UnitOrder
 End
GO

create  PROCEDURE [dbo].[PrdIns_Upd_Openstock]
	@EntryDate date,
	@ItemId int,
	@ItemCode varchar(50),
	@IBarCode varchar(50),
	@pRate decimal,
	@sRate decimal,
	@MRP decimal,
	@Stk decimal,
	@QOH decimal,
	@Diff decimal,
	@CreatedBy int,
	@ModifiedBy int,
	@Status int,
	@BranchId int,
	@Remarks varchar(max),
	@Unitid int
AS
  declare @currdate datetime
    /**set @currdate = convert(varchar, getdate(), 120)*/
	set @currdate = getdate()

BEGIN
   declare @count bigint;
   select @count = (select count(*) from tblOpStk where ItemId=@ItemId and EntryDate=@EntryDate)
	if @count > 0
		begin
			update tblOpStk set EntryDate=@EntryDate ,ItemId=@ItemId ,ItemCode=@ItemCode,IBarCode=@IBarCode ,pRate=@pRate ,sRate=@sRate ,MRP=@MRP ,Stk=@Stk ,QOH=@QOH ,Diff=@Diff ,BranchId=@BranchId ,Remarks=@Remarks ,Unitid=@Unitid ,ModifiedBy=@ModifiedBy
			,ModifiedDateTime=getdate() where  ItemId=@ItemId and EntryDate=@EntryDate
		end
		if @count <= 0
		begin
			insert into tblOpStk(EntryDate,ItemId,ItemCode,IBarCode,pRate,sRate,MRP,Stk,QOH,Diff,CreatedBy,CreatedDateTime,Status,BranchId,Remarks,Unitid)
			values(	@EntryDate ,@ItemId ,@ItemCode ,@IBarCode ,	@pRate ,@sRate ,@MRP ,@Stk ,@QOH ,@Diff ,@CreatedBy ,@currdate , @Status ,@BranchId ,@Remarks ,@Unitid );
		end
END
GO

@TaxSettingsId int,
@QOH decimal(10,3),
@UPC nvarchar(50),
@Prate decimal(10,3),
@Srate decimal(10,3),
@MRP decimal(10,3),
@Status int,

As


Declare @Id bigint; 


Begin

		SET @Id= @ProductId
		update tblProductRate set PRate=@Prate,SRate=@Srate,MRP=@MRP where Id=@PrId

		CreatedBy,BranchId,Status,Tax,TaxTypeId,TaxSettingsId,CreatedOn)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PrdInsert_Upd_CardProductLocMapping]
@product int,
@Location int,
@Status int,
@CreatedBy int,
@ProductType int
AS
Declare @Count int
BEGIN
	Select @Count=Count(*)from tblCardProductLocMapping where Product=@product and Location=@Location  and ProductType=@ProductType
	
	if (@Count >0)
	begin
	Update tblCardProductLocMapping set Product=@product,Location=@Location,status=@Status,modifiedBy=@CreatedBy,ModifiedOn=SYSDATETIME() where product=@product and Location=@Location and ProductType=@ProductType ;
	end
	else
	begin
	insert into tblCardProductLocMapping(product,location,Status,createdby,CreatedOn,ProductType)
	values(@product,@Location,@Status,@CreatedBy,SYSDATETIME(),@ProductType);
	end


END

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[prdInsert_Upd_CustAccount]
@AccId int,
@EnrollDate date,
@AccNo nvarchar(50),
@AccName nvarchar(50),
@AccAddress nvarchar(50),
@gender int,
@dob date,
@age int,
@cInstitute nvarchar(50),
@Occupation nvarchar(50),
@AccPhone nvarchar(50),
@zipcode int, 
@cEmergency nvarchar(50),
@cCountry nvarchar(50),
@State nvarchar(50),
@city nvarchar(100),
@AccEmail nvarchar(50),
@AllowSMS int,
@AllowEmail int,
@Proof int,
@ProofNo nvarchar(50),
@Remark nvarchar(50),
@proofimg1 nvarchar(50),
@CreatedBy bigint,
@BranchId bigint,
@Status int,
@ICardNo nvarchar(100),
@CardType int,
@MemberShip int
As
Declare @Id bigint;
declare @p_ID bigint;


Begin
if @AccId>0
	begin
		update tblAccountLedger set EnrollDate=@EnrollDate,LedgerCode=@AccNo,LedgerName=@AccName,
		LedgerAddress=@AccAddress,gender =@gender,dob=@dob,age=@age,cInstitute=@cInstitute,Occupation=@Occupation,
		Mobile=@AccPhone,zipcode =@zipcode,cEmergency =@cEmergency ,cCountry =@cCountry ,State =@State,
		city =@city ,EmailId =@AccEmail ,AllowSMS =@AllowSMS ,AllowEmail =@AllowEmail,Proof =@Proof ,ProofNo =@ProofNo,cardtype=@CardType,
		Remarks=@Remark,proofimg1 =@proofimg1,ModifiedDateTime=SYSDATETIME(),
		BranchId =@BranchId,
		Status=@Status,ICardNo=@ICardNo,MemberShip=@MemberShip
		where LedgerId=@AccId 
		SET @Id= @AccId
	end
else
	begin
		    set @AccNo= (Select MAX(CAST(LedgerCode AS bigint)) AS LedgerCode from tblAccountLedger);
		Insert into tblAccountLedger(EnrollDate,LedgerCode,LedgerName,LedgerAddress,gender,dob,age,cInstitute,Occupation,
		Mobile,zipcode,cEmergency,cCountry,State,city ,EmailId ,AllowSMS,AllowEmail,Proof ,ProofNo,
		Remarks,proofimg1,CreatedBy,BranchId ,Status,ICardNo,cardtype,cardstatus,MemberShip,CreatedDateTime)
		values(@EnrollDate,@AccNo,@AccName,@AccAddress,@gender ,@dob,@age,@cInstitute,@Occupation ,
		@AccPhone ,@zipcode ,@cEmergency ,@cCountry ,@State,@city ,@AccEmail ,@AllowSMS ,@AllowEmail,@Proof ,@ProofNo,
		@Remark,@proofimg1,@CreatedBy,@BranchId ,@Status,@ICardNo,@CardType,1,@MemberShip,SYSDATETIME())

		Set @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY()
		
	end
	SELECT @ID  as LedgerId
RETURN 

End

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[prdInsert_Upd_FamilyCardsMaster]
@FCardId int,
@InvNo nvarchar(50),
@CustomerId int,@CustomerName nvarchar(50),@Address nvarchar(100),
@Email nvarchar(50),@Phone nvarchar(50),@ProductId int,@ProductName nvarchar(50),@ExpDate datetime,
@Price decimal(10,2),@NoOfCards int,@Status int,@CreatedBy bigint,
@ModifiedBy int,@BranchId bigint,@TotalGross decimal(10,2),
@DiscountPer decimal(10,2),@DiscountAmount decimal(10,2),@OaAmount decimal(10,2),@OaDesc nvarchar(50),
@OdAmount decimal(10,2),@OdDesc nvarchar(50),@NetAmount decimal(10,2),@RcvAmnt decimal(10,2),@BalAmnt decimal(10,2),@Terms nvarchar(200),
@MasterCardNo nvarchar(100),
@CashBalance decimal(10,4),
@CashBonusBalnce decimal(10,4),
@CardAcessType int,
@totalqty int,
@TaxType int,
@Tax nvarchar(50),
@TaxPer decimal(10,4),
@TaxAmount decimal(10,4)

As
Declare @Id bigint;
Declare @CreatedOn datetime;
Declare @ModifiedOn datetime;
    /*set @currdate = convert(varchar, getdate(), 120)*/
	set @CreatedOn = getdate();
	set @ModifiedOn = getdate() 
Begin
if @FCardId>0
	begin
		update tblFamilyCardsMaster set InvNo=@InvNo,
		CustomerId=@CustomerId, CustomerName= @CustomerName, Address= @Address, 
		Email= @Email, Phone= @Phone, ProductId= @ProductId, ProductName= @ProductName
		, ExpDate= @ExpDate, Price= @Price, NoOfCards= @NoOfCards,
		ModifiedBy =@CreatedBy,ModifiedOn=@ModifiedOn,
		TotalGross=@TotalGross,DiscountPer=@DiscountPer,DiscountAmount=@DiscountAmount
		,OaAmount=@OaAmount,OaDesc=@OaDesc,OdAmount=@OdAmount,
		OdDesc=@OdDesc ,NetAmount=@NetAmount ,RcvAmnt=@RcvAmnt ,BalAmnt=@BalAmnt,
		BranchId =@BranchId ,Status=@Status,Terms=@Terms,MasterCardNo=@MasterCardNo,TaxType=@TaxType,Tax=@Tax,TaxPer=@TaxPer,TaxAmount=@TaxAmount,
		CashBonusBalnce=CashBonusBalnce+@CashBonusBalnce,CashBalance=CashBalance+@CashBalance
		where FCardId=@FCardId 
		SET @Id= @FCardId

	end
else
	begin
		Insert into tblFamilyCardsMaster(InvNo,Date ,CustomerId,CustomerName,Address, Email,Phone,
		ProductId,ProductName,ExpDate,Price,NoOfCards,CreatedOn,CreatedBy ,
		BranchId ,Status,TotalGross,DiscountPer,DiscountAmount,OaAmount,OaDesc,OdAmount,
		OdDesc ,NetAmount ,RcvAmnt ,BalAmnt,Terms,MasterCardNo,CashBalance,CashBonusBalnce,CardAcessType,TaxType,Tax,TaxPer,TaxAmount)
		values(@InvNo,SYSDATETIME(),@CustomerId,@CustomerName,@Address,@Email,@Phone, @ProductId,@ProductName,@ExpDate,
		@Price,@NoOfCards,@CreatedOn,@CreatedBy ,@BranchId ,@Status,@TotalGross,@DiscountPer,
		@DiscountAmount,@OaAmount,@OaDesc,@OdAmount,@OdDesc,@NetAmount,@RcvAmnt,@BalAmnt,@Terms,@MasterCardNo,@CashBalance,@CashBonusBalnce,@CardAcessType,@TaxType,@Tax,@TaxPer,@TaxAmount)
		
		update tblLocationDetails set FCardSrlNo=FCardSrlNo+1 where LocId=@BranchId
		update tblCard set QOH=QOH - @totalqty

		Set @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY()
		
	end
	SELECT @ID  as FCardId
RETURN 

End

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PrdInsert_Upd_GameLocMapping]
@Game int,
@MacID varchar(50),
@Location int,
@Status int,
@CreatedBy int,
@Price decimal,
@VipRate decimal
AS
Declare @Count int
Declare @Count1 int
BEGIN
	Select @Count=Count(*)from tblGameLocMapping where Game=@Game and [Location]=@Location  
	Select @Count1=Count(*)from tblGameRate where GameId=@Game and BranchId=@Location  

	if (@Count >0)
	begin
	Update tblGameLocMapping set game=@Game,MacID=@MacID,Location=@Location,status=@Status,modifiedBy=@CreatedBy,ModifiedDateTime=SYSDATETIME(),Price=@Price,VIPPrice=@VipRate where Game=@Game and Location=@Location ;
	end
	else
	begin
	insert into tblGameLocMapping(game,MacID,location,Status,createdby,CreatedDatetime,Price,VIPPrice)
	values(@Game,@MacID,@Location,@Status,@CreatedBy,SYSDATETIME(),@Price,@VipRate);	
	end
	--Updating The Game Price
	if (@Count1 >0)
	begin
		update tblGameRate set Rate=@Price,VIPRate=@Viprate
		where GameId=@Game and BranchId=@Location
		end
	else
	begin
		insert into tblGameRate(GameId,Rate,VIPRate,Status,BranchId)
		values(@Game,@Price,@Viprate,1,@Location)	
	end


END
GO

 CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdInsert_Upd_GatePass]
@ProductId int,
@Description nvarchar(50),
@SuggestedPrice decimal(10,2),
@CashBalance decimal(10,2),
@CashBonusBalance decimal(10,2),
@TokenBalance decimal(10,2),
@Points decimal(10,2),
@DurationMin int,
@DepartmentId int,
@MemberShipPromo int,
@BlockAccess int,
@CreatedBy bigint,
@BranchId bigint,
@Status int,
@Tax varchar(50),
@TaxSettingsId int
As
Declare @Id bigint; 


Begin
if @ProductId>0
	begin
		update tblGatePass set Description=@Description,SuggestedPrice=@SuggestedPrice,CashBalance =@CashBalance,
		CashBonusBalance=@CashBonusBalance,TokenBalance=@TokenBalance,DepartmentId=@DepartmentId,
		Points=@Points,DurationMin=@DurationMin,MemberShipPromo=@MemberShipPromo,BlockAccess=@BlockAccess,
		ModifiedBy=@CreatedBy,ModifiedOn=SYSDATETIME(),BranchId =@BranchId ,TaxSettingsId=@TaxSettingsId,Tax=@Tax,
		Status=@Status where ProductId=@ProductId 
		SET @Id= @ProductId
	end
else
	begin

		Insert into tblGatePass(Description,SuggestedPrice,CashBalance,DepartmentId,

		@Points,@DurationMin,@MemberShipPromo,@BlockAccess,@CreatedBy,SYSDATETIME(),@BranchId,@Status,@Tax,@TaxSettingsId)

		Set @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY()
		
	end
	SELECT @ID  as ProductId
RETURN 

End

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[prdInsert_Upd_LockerHire]
@LockHireID int,
@EntryDate date,
@LockID int,
@AccID int,
@AccNo nvarchar(50),
@AccPhone nvarchar(10),
@AccEmail nvarchar(50),
@CustomerPin int,
@HireFor int,
@RateType int,
@Rate decimal(18,2),
@Amt decimal(18,2),
@ExpDate date,
@ExpTime smalldatetime,
@HireDate date,
@HireTime smalldatetime,
@LockOpen int,
@Inotes nvarchar(50),
@Hiredetail nvarchar(50),
@Hireno int,
@CreatedBy int,
@ModifiedBy int,
@BranchId int,
@Status int,
@Hired int,
@PaymentMode int,
@NetAmount decimal(18,2),
@PaidAmount decimal(18,2),
@BalanceAmount decimal(18,2),
@AmountAdjust decimal(18,2),
@DiscountAmount decimal(18,2),
@ICardNo nvarchar(100)


As
Declare @Id bigint;

Begin
if @LockHireID>0
	begin
		update tblLockerHire set EntryDate=@EntryDate ,LockID=@LockID,AccID=@AccID ,AccNo=@AccNo ,AccPhone=@AccPhone ,AccEmail=@AccEmail ,CustomerPin=@CustomerPin,HireFor=@HireFor ,
								RateType=@RateType,Rate=@Rate,Amt=@Amt,ExpDate=@ExpDate,ExpTime=@ExpTime,HireDate=@HireDate,HireTime=@HireTime,LockOpen=@LockOpen ,Inotes=@Inotes ,
								Hiredetail=@Hiredetail ,Hireno=@Hireno ,ModifiedBy=@ModifiedBy ,ModifiedDateTime=SYSDATETIME(), BranchId=@BranchId ,Status=@Status ,Hired=@Hired ,PaymentMode=@PaymentMode, NetAmount=@NetAmount, PaidAmount=@PaidAmount,BalanceAmount=@BalanceAmount,AmountAdjust=@AmountAdjust,DiscountAmount=@DiscountAmount,ICardNo=@ICardNo
		where LockHireID=@LockHireID
		SELECT @Id= @LockHireID
        update tblLocker set Hired=@Hired where ID=@LockID
	end
else
	begin

		Insert into tblLockerHire(EntryDate ,LockID ,AccID ,AccNo ,AccPhone ,AccEmail ,CustomerPin ,HireFor ,RateType ,Rate ,Amt ,ExpDate ,
											ExpTime ,HireDate ,HireTime ,LockOpen ,Inotes ,Hiredetail ,Hireno ,CreatedBy ,CreatedDateTime,BranchId ,Status,Hired,PaymentMode,NetAmount,PaidAmount,BalanceAmount,AmountAdjust,DiscountAmount,ICardNo)
		values(@EntryDate ,@LockID ,@AccID ,@AccNo ,@AccPhone ,@AccEmail ,@CustomerPin ,@HireFor ,@RateType ,@Rate ,@Amt ,@ExpDate ,@ExpTime ,@HireDate ,
				@HireTime ,@LockOpen ,@Inotes ,@Hiredetail ,@Hireno ,@CreatedBy ,SYSDATETIME(),@BranchId ,@Status,@Hired,@PaymentMode,@NetAmount,@PaidAmount,@BalanceAmount,@AmountAdjust,@DiscountAmount,@ICardNo )
			update tblLocker set Hired=@Hired where ID=@LockID
	

		Set @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY()
		
	end
	select @Id as id
RETURN (select LockHireID as id from tblLockerHire where LockHireID=@ID)

End

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PrdInsert_Upd_LocWorkTime]
@LocId int,
@DayId int,
@FromTime time,
@ToTime time,
@Status int,
@CreatedBy int
as
declare @count int
BEGIN
select  @count= COUNT(*) from tblLocationWorkTime where LocId=@LocId and DayId=@DayId and status=1;
if(@count>0)
begin
update tblLocationWorkTime set FromTime=@FromTime,ToTime=@ToTime,Status=@Status,ModifiedBy=@CreatedBy,ModifiedDateTime=SYSDATETIME() where LocId=@LocId and DayId=@DayId ;
end
else
begin
	Insert into tblLocationWorkTime(LocId,DayId,FromTime,ToTime,Status,CreatedBy,CreatedDateTime)
	values(@LocId,@DayId,@FromTime,@ToTime,@Status,@CreatedBy,SYSDATETIME());
end
END

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[prdInsert_Upd_Marchandise]

		SET @Id= @ProductId

	end

 CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdInsert_Upd_MemberShip]

		@DisPer,@DisAmnt,@OaAmount,@OdAmount,@NetAmount,@OaDesc,@OdDesc,@RcvAmnt,@BalAmnt,@Remark,@Terms,@CreatedBy ,
		@ModifiedBy,@BranchId ,@Status,@LoylityPoint,@BonusPoint,SYSDATETIME(),
		@TotalTax,@TotalIGST,@TotalCGST,@TotalSGST,@TotalVAT,@mDevice,@mDeviceIP,@CusName,@CardPrice,@NewCardCount)
		Set @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY()	
	end
	SELECT @ID  as CardSalesMasterId
RETURN 
End

 CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdInsert_Upd_PurchaseDetails]
@PurchaseDetailId int,
@PurchaseMasterId int,
@Barcode nvarchar(100),
@Name nvarchar(100),
@Unit nvarchar(50),
@Tax nvarchar(20),
@TaxType nvarchar(20),
@Type nvarchar(20),
@QTY decimal(18,2),
@Prate decimal(18,2),
@Amount decimal(18,2),
@DisPer decimal(18,2),
@DisAmnt decimal(18,2),
@TotalAmnt decimal(18,2),
@TaxAmount decimal(18,2),
@TaxPer decimal(18,2),
@MRP decimal(18,2),
@Srate decimal(18,2),
@ItemId int,
@UnitId int,
@CreatedBy bigint,
@ModifiedBy int,
@BranchId bigint,
@Status int,
@PrId int
As
Declare @Id bigint;
Declare @Cnt bigint;
Declare @curr_qty decimal(10,2);
Declare @sugpointvalue decimal;
Declare @sugcouponvalue decimal;
Begin
if @PurchaseDetailId>0
	begin
		update tblPurchaseDetails set PurchaseMasterId=@PurchaseMasterId,ItemBarCode=@Barcode,
		ItemCode=@Name, Quantity= @QTY, PurchaseRate= @Prate, Amount= @Amount, 
		DiscountPer= @DisPer, DiscountAmount= @DisAmnt,TaxAmount=@TaxAmount,TaxPer=@TaxPer,MRP=@MRP,
		Srate=@Srate,NetAmount= @TotalAmnt, ItemId= @ItemId, TaxType= @Tax, ProductType= @Type, 
		UnitId= @UnitId,CreatedBy =@CreatedBy,ModifiedBy=@ModifiedBy ,BranchId =@BranchId,Status=@Status 
		where PurchaseDetailId=@PurchaseDetailId
		SET @Id= @PurchaseDetailId
	end
else
	begin

		 if @Type=2
		begin
			 set @curr_qty= (Select QOH from tblCard where LocationId = @BranchId ) ; 
	     end
	 else
		begin
			 set @curr_qty= (Select Sum(QOH) from tblProductRate pr where pr.ProductId = @ItemId and pr.BranchId = @BranchId and pr.ProductType = @Type) ; 
		end

		Insert into tblPurchaseDetails(PurchaseMasterId,ItemBarCode ,ItemCode,Quantity,PurchaseRate,
		Amount,DiscountPer,DiscountAmount,TaxAmount,TaxPer,Srate,MRP,NetAmount,ItemId,UnitId,CreatedBy,ModifiedBy ,
		BranchId ,Status,Tax,TaxType,ProductType,CreatedDateTime,FreeQuantity)
		values(@PurchaseMasterId,@Barcode,@Name,@QTY,@Prate,@Amount,@DisPer, @DisAmnt,@TaxAmount,@TaxPer
		,@Srate,@MRP,@TotalAmnt,@ItemId,@UnitId,@CreatedBy ,@ModifiedBy,@BranchId ,@Status,@Tax,@TaxType,@Type,SYSDATETIME(),@curr_qty)
		Set @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY()
		
		--if @Type = 3
		--begin			
		--		update tblFoodAndBeverages set QOH=QOH+@QTY where ProductId = @ItemId			
		--end
		--else if @Type =2 
		--begin
		--	update tblMarchandise set QOH=QOH+@QTY where ProductId = @ItemId
		--end
		--else if @Type = 3
		--begin
		--	update tblBowlingAccessories set QOH=QOH+@QTY where ProductId = @ItemId
		--end
		--else if @Type = 4
		--begin
		--	update tblRedemptionProducts set QOH=QOH+@QTY where ProductId = @ItemId
		--end
		if @Type=6
	     begin
			Select   @sugcouponvalue=ld.TokenBalEqu ,@sugpointvalue=ld.PointBalEqu 
			from tblLocationDetails ld  Where ld.Status = 1 and ld.LocId=1026
			update tblRedemptionProducts set SuggestedCouponValue=@Srate*@sugcouponvalue,
			SuggestedPointValue=@Srate*@sugpointvalue where ProductId=@ItemId
			 
		 end

		 if @Type=5
	     begin
			update tblCard set QOH=QOH+@QTY where CardId = @ItemId
		 end
		 else 
		 begin
			Select @Cnt=Count(*)from tblProductRate 
			where ProductId=@ItemId and ProductType=@Type and PRate=@Prate and SRate=@Srate and MRP=@MRP and BranchId=@BranchId and Status=1
			if @Cnt=0
			begin
				insert into tblProductRate(ProductId,ProductType,PRate,SRate,MRP,QOH,Status,BranchId)
								values(@ItemId,@Type,@Prate,@Srate,@MRP,@QTY,1,@BranchId)
								Set @Prid=SCOPE_IDENTITY()
			end
			else 
			begin
				update tblProductRate set QOH=QOH+@QTY where  ProductId=@ItemId and ProductType=@Type and PRate=@Prate and SRate=@Srate and MRP=@MRP and BranchId=@BranchId and Status=1
				--Set @Prid=SCOPE_IDENTITY()
			end
		end
		update tblPurchaseDetails set PrId=@Prid where PurchaseDetailId=@Id
	end
	SELECT @ID  as PurchaseDetailId

RETURN 

End
GO

	end

		Set @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY()
		
		update tblLocationDetails set PurchaseSrlNo=PurchaseSrlNo+1 where LocId=@BranchId
	end
	SELECT @ID  as PurchaseMasterId
RETURN 

End

@BranchId bigint,@PurchaseDetailId int,@Status int,@Type nvarchar(20),@Typetax nvarchar(20),@PrId int,@TaxPer decimal(10,2),@TaxAmount decimal(10,2),@Tax varchar(20)
As

Declare @curr_qty decimal(10,2);
Begin
if @PurchaseReturnDetailId>0
	begin
		update tblPurchaseReturnDetails set PurchaseReturnMasterId=@PurchaseReturnMasterId,ItemBarCode=@Barcode,
		ItemCode=@Name, Quantity= @QTY, PurchaseRate= @Prate, Amount= @Amount, 
		DiscountPer= @DisPer, DiscountAmount= @DisAmnt, NetAmount= @TotalAmnt, ItemId= @ItemId, 
		UnitId= @UnitId,CreatedBy =@CreatedBy,ModifiedBy=@ModifiedBy ,BranchId =@BranchId,Status=@Status 
		where PurchaseReturnDetailsId=@PurchaseReturnDetailId
		SET @Id= @PurchaseReturnDetailId
	end
else
	begin
		 if @Type=2
		begin
			 set @curr_qty= (Select QOH from tblCard where LocationId = @BranchId ) ; 
	     end

		begin
			 set @curr_qty= (Select Sum(QOH) from tblProductRate pr where pr.ProductId = @ItemId and pr.BranchId = @BranchId and pr.ProductType = @Type) ;

		begin
			update tblCard set QOH=QOH-@QTY where CardId = @ItemId
	     end
	 else
		begin
			update tblProductRate set QOH=QOH-@QTY where  Id=@PrId
		end
		
	end
	SELECT @ID  as PurchaseReturnDetailsId

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PrdInsert_Upd_RedeemptionDetails]
	@ProductId int,
	@Product varchar(100),
	@BarCode varchar(100),
	@Point decimal,
	@Qty decimal,
	@Net decimal,
	@RedemId int,
	@CreatedBy int,
	@PrId int,
	@BranchId int
AS
Declare @count int
Declare @freequantity decimal
BEGIN
 set @freequantity =(Select Sum(QOH) from tblProductRate where ProductType=6 and ProductId=@ProductId and BranchId=@BranchId group by ProductId)	
 select  @count= COUNT(*)from tblRedeemptionDetails where RedemId=@RedemId and ProductId=@ProductId and Status=1
	if @count !=0
	begin
	Update tblRedeemptionDetails set Status=0,ModifiedBy=@CreatedBy,ModifiedOn=SYSDATETIME() where RedemId=@RedemId and ProductId=@ProductId and Status=1
	end
	insert into tblRedeemptionDetails(ProductId,Product,BarCode,Point,Qty,Net,RedemId,CreatedBy,CreatedOn,Status,BranchId,PrId)
	values(@ProductId,@Product,@BarCode,@Point,@Qty,@Net,@RedemId,@CreatedBy,SYSDATETIME(),1,@BranchId,@PrId)
	update tblProductRate set QOH=QOH-@Qty where Id=@PrId

END
GO

 CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdInsert_Upd_RedemptionProducts]

@Description nvarchar(50),
@SuggestedPointValue decimal(10,2),
@Price decimal(10,2),
@SuggestedCouponValue decimal(10,2),
@UPC nvarchar(50),
@CreatedBy bigint,
@Prate decimal(18,3),
@Srate decimal(18,3),
@MRP decimal(18,3),
@QOH int,
@Status int,
@TaxSettingsId int,
@Tax varchar(50),
@BranchId bigint,
@ProductType int,
@PrId int
As
Declare @Id bigint; 


Begin
if @ProductId>0
	begin
		update tblRedemptionProducts set Description=@Description,
		SuggestedPointValue=@SuggestedPointValue,SuggestedCouponValue=@SuggestedCouponValue,
		UPC=@UPC,
		ModifiedBy=CreatedBy,ModifiedOn=SYSDATETIME(),BranchId =@BranchId ,
		Status=@Status,TaxSettingsId=@TaxSettingsId,Tax=@Tax where ProductId=@ProductId 
		SET @Id= @ProductId
		update tblProductRate set PRate=@Prate,SRate=@Srate,MRP=@MRP where Id=@PrId
	end
else
	begin

		Insert into tblRedemptionProducts(Description,SuggestedPointValue,
		SuggestedCouponValue,UPC,CreatedBy,BranchId,Status,TaxSettingsId,Tax,CreatedOn)
		values(@Description,@SuggestedPointValue,@SuggestedCouponValue,@UPC
		,@CreatedBy ,@BranchId,@Status,@TaxSettingsId,@Tax,SYSDATETIME())
		Set @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY()

		insert into tblProductRate(ProductId,ProductType,PRate,SRate,MRP,QOH,Status,BranchId)
		values(@Id,@ProductType,@Prate,@Srate,@MRP,@QOH,1,@BranchId)

		
	end
	SELECT @ID  as ProductId
RETURN 

End

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[prdInsert_Upd_SalesDetails]
@CardSalesDetailId int,@CardSalesMasterId int,@Product_id int,@Barcode nvarchar(20),@Name nvarchar(100),
@Unit nvarchar(50),@Tax varchar(50),@Type nvarchar(20),
@QTY decimal(18,2),@Prate decimal(18,2),@Amount decimal(18,2),@DisPer decimal(18,2),@DisAmnt decimal(18,2),
@TotalAmnt decimal(18,2),@TaxPer decimal(18,2),@TaxAmount decimal(18,2),@MRP decimal(18,2),@Srate decimal(18,2),@ItemId int,
@UnitId int,@CreatedBy bigint,@ModifiedBy int,
@BranchId bigint,@Status int,
@CustomerId int,@CashBonusBalance decimal(18,2),@TokenBalance decimal(18,2),@PointBalance decimal(18,2),
@loypoints decimal(18,2),@BonusPoint decimal (18,2),
@IgstAmount decimal(18,2),@CgstAmount decimal(18,2),@SgstAmount decimal(18,2),@VatAmount decimal(18,2),
@CardBalance decimal(18,2),@ICardNo nvarchar(50),@Prid int,@TaxType varchar(100),
@Address  varchar(Max),@EmailId  varchar(100),@Mobile  varchar(100),@NameFlag int,@Customer varchar(100)
As
Declare @Id bigint;
Declare @Cid bigint;
Declare @Ledgeno varchar(Max);
Declare @customername varchar(max);
Begin
if @Type = 2 or @Type = 4 or @Type = 5 or @Type = 7
begin
		if (@CustomerId>0)
			begin
			update tblAccountLedger set CashBonusBalance=(CashBonusBalance+(@CashBonusBalance*@QTY)),TokenBalance=(TokenBalance+(@TokenBalance*@QTY)),
			PointBalance=(PointBalance+(@PointBalance*@QTY)),CardBalance=(CardBalance+(@CardBalance*@QTY)),loypoints=loypoints+@loypoints,ModifiedBy=@ModifiedBy,ModifiedDateTime=SYSDATETIME()	
			where LedgerId=@CustomerId
			SET @Cid= @CustomerId
			end
		else
			begin
			set @Ledgeno=(select MAX(CAST(LedgerCode AS bigint)) + 1  AS LedgerCode from tblAccountLedger);

			if(@NameFlag =1)
				set @customername= @Customer +' '+  @Ledgeno;
			else
				set @customername=@Customer;

			INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblAccountLedger] ([loypoints],LedgerCode,ICardNo,CardBalance,[CashBonusBalance],[TokenBalance],[PointBalance]
			,CreatedBy,CreatedDateTime,BranchId ,Status,EnrollDate,dob,cardstatus,LedgerName,LedgerAddress,EmailId,Mobile)
			 VALUES(@loypoints,@Ledgeno,@ICardNo,(@CardBalance*@QTY),(@CashBonusBalance*@QTY),(@TokenBalance*@QTY),(@PointBalance*@QTY),@CreatedBy,SYSDATETIME(),@BranchId ,@Status,SYSDATETIME(),SYSDATETIME(),1,
			 @customername,@Address,@EmailId,@Mobile)
			Set @Cid=SCOPE_IDENTITY()
			update tblCard set QOH=QOH-1 where LocationId = @BranchId
			end

End
if @CardSalesDetailId>0
	begin
		update tblSalesDetails set SalesMasterId=@CardSalesMasterId,ItemBarCode=@Barcode,
		ItemCode=@Name, Quantity= @QTY, PurchaseRate= @Prate, Amount= @Amount, 
		DiscountPer= @DisPer, DiscountAmount= @DisAmnt,TaxPer=@TaxPer,TaxAmount=@TaxAmount,MRP=@MRP,
		SalesRate=@Srate,NetAmount= @TotalAmnt, ItemId= @ItemId, Tax= @Tax, ProductType= @Type, 
		UnitId= @UnitId,ModifiedDateTime = SYSDATETIME(),ModifiedBy=@ModifiedBy ,BranchId =@BranchId,Status=@Status, 
		IgstAmount=@IgstAmount,CgstAmount=@CgstAmount,SgstAmount=@SgstAmount,VatAmount=@VatAmount,ICardNo=@ICardNo,TaxType=@TaxType 
		where SalesDetailsId=@CardSalesDetailId
		SET @Id= @CardSalesDetailId
	end
else
	begin
		Insert into tblSalesDetails(SalesMasterId,ItemBarCode ,ItemCode,Quantity,PurchaseRate,
		Amount,DiscountPer,DiscountAmount,TaxPer,TaxAmount,SalesRate,MRP,NetAmount,ItemId,UnitId,CreatedBy,CreatedDateTime,ModifiedBy ,
		BranchId ,Status,Tax,ProductType,IgstAmount,CgstAmount,SgstAmount,VatAmount,ICardNo,LedgerId,prid,TaxType)
		values(@CardSalesMasterId,@Barcode,@Name,@QTY,@Prate,@Amount,@DisPer, @DisAmnt,@TaxPer,@TaxAmount
		,@Srate,@MRP,@TotalAmnt,@ItemId,@UnitId,@CreatedBy,SYSDATETIME() ,@ModifiedBy,@BranchId ,@Status,@Tax,@Type,
		@IgstAmount,@CgstAmount,@SgstAmount,@VatAmount,@ICardNo,@Cid,@Prid,@TaxType)

		Set @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY()

		if @Type != 2 or @Type != 4 or @Type != 5 or @Type != 7
		
		begin
			update tblProductRate set QOH = QOH - @QTY where id=@Prid
		end		
	end
	SELECT @ID  as CardSalesDetailId
RETURN 

End
GO

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[prdInsert_Upd_SalesMaster]
@CardSalesMasterId int,
@EntryNo nvarchar(20),@DocNo nvarchar(20),@DocDate date,@Customer nvarchar(50),@Address nvarchar(200),
@ContactNo nvarchar(20),@Email nvarchar(50),@TotQty decimal(18,2),@TotalAmnt decimal(18,2),@GrandTot decimal(18,2),
@TotalDiscount decimal(18,2),@DisPer decimal(18,2),@DisAmnt decimal(18,2),@OaAmount decimal(18,2),@OdAmount decimal(18,2),
@NetAmount decimal(18,2),@OaDesc nvarchar(50),@OdDesc nvarchar(50),@RcvAmnt decimal(18,2),@BalAmnt decimal(18,2),
@Remark nvarchar(50),@Terms nvarchar(50),@CreatedBy bigint,@ModifiedBy int,@BranchId bigint,@Status int,
@LoylityPoint decimal(18,2),@BonusPoint decimal(18,2),
@TotalTax decimal(18,2),@TotalIGST decimal(18,2),@TotalCGST decimal(18,2),@TotalSGST decimal(18,2),@TotalVAT decimal(18,2),
@mDevice varchar(100),@mDeviceIP varchar(100),@CusName nvarchar(50),@CardPrice decimal(18,2),@NewCardCount int,@PayId int
As
Declare @Id bigint;
Begin
if @CardSalesMasterId>0
	begin
		update tblSalesMaster set EntryNo=@EntryNo,EntryDate=@DocDate,
		LedgerId=@Customer, SalesAddress= @Address, Telephone= @ContactNo, 
		Email= @Email, TotalQuantity= @TotQty, TotalAmount= @TotalAmnt, TotalGross= @GrandTot
		, TotalDiscount= @TotalDiscount, DiscountPer= @DisPer, DiscountAmount= @DisAmnt, OaAmount= @OaAmount
		, OdAmount= @OdAmount, NetAmount= @NetAmount, OaDesc= @OaDesc, OdDesc= @OdDesc,
		RcvAmnt= @RcvAmnt,BalAmnt= @BalAmnt,Remarks= @Remark,Terms= @Terms,ModifiedDateTime = SYSDATETIME(),
		ModifiedBy=@CreatedBy,BranchId =@BranchId ,CusName = @CusName,
		Status=@Status,LoylityPoint=@LoylityPoint,BonusPoint=@BonusPoint,
		TotalTax=@TotalTax,TotalIGST=@TotalIGST,TotalCGST=@TotalCGST,TotalSGST=@TotalSGST,TotalVAT=@TotalVAT,
		mDevice=@mDevice,mDeviceIP=@mDeviceIP,CardPrice=@CardPrice,NewCardCount=@NewCardCount
		where SalesMasterId=@CardSalesMasterId 
		SET @Id= @CardSalesMasterId
	end
else
	begin
		Insert into tblSalesMaster(EntryNo,EntryDate ,LedgerId,SalesAddress,Telephone, Email,TotalQuantity,
		TotalAmount,TotalGross,TotalDiscount,DiscountPer,DiscountAmount,OaAmount,OdAmount,NetAmount,OaDesc,OdDesc,
		RcvAmnt,BalAmnt,Remarks,Terms,CreatedBy,ModifiedBy ,
		BranchId ,Status,LoylityPoint,BonusPoint,CreatedDateTime,
		TotalTax,TotalIGST,TotalCGST,TotalSGST,TotalVAT,mDevice,mDeviceIP,CusName,CardPrice,NewCardCount,PaymentMode)
		values(@EntryNo,@DocDate,@Customer,@Address,@ContactNo,@Email,@TotQty, @TotalAmnt,@GrandTot,@TotalDiscount,
		@DisPer,@DisAmnt,@OaAmount,@OdAmount,@NetAmount,@OaDesc,@OdDesc,@RcvAmnt,@BalAmnt,@Remark,@Terms,@CreatedBy ,
		@ModifiedBy,@BranchId ,@Status,@LoylityPoint,@BonusPoint,SYSDATETIME(),
		@TotalTax,@TotalIGST,@TotalCGST,@TotalSGST,@TotalVAT,@mDevice,@mDeviceIP,@CusName,@CardPrice,@NewCardCount,@PayId)
		Set @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY()	
		update tblLocationDetails set SalesSrlNo=SalesSrlNo+1 where LocId=@BranchId
	end
	SELECT @ID  as CardSalesMasterId
RETURN 
End

	end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PrdInsert_UpdGroupSale_SalesDetials]
@SalesMasterId int,
@ItemId int,
@ItemBarCode varchar(100),
@ItemCode varchar(100),
@NetAmount decimal,
@Quantity int,
@CreatedBy int,
@BranchId int,
@ProductType int,
@Status int,
@TaxAmount decimal,
@IGSTAmount decimal,
@SGSTAmount decimal,
@CGSTAmount decimal,
@VatAmount decimal,
@SalesRate decimal,
@Tax varchar(100),
@TaxType int,
@TaxPer decimal,
@prid int,
@DiscountAmount decimal,
@Amount decimal,
@DiscountPer decimal
AS
declare @count int;
Declare @freequantity decimal;
BEGIN	
set @freequantity =(Select Sum(QOH) from tblProductRate where ProductType=6 and ProductId=@ItemId and BranchId=@BranchId group by ProductId)
	if(@ProductType=9 OR @ProductType=10)
		begin
		update tblCard set QOH=QOH-@Quantity
		/*set @Quantity=1*/
		end
	else if(@ProductType=6)
		begin
		update tblProductRate set QOH=QOH-@Quantity where Id=@prid 
		end
	insert into tblSalesDetails(SalesMasterId,ItemId,ItemBarCode,ItemCode,NetAmount,Quantity,CreatedBy,CreatedDateTime,BranchId,ProductType,Status,
	TaxAmount,IGSTAmount,SGSTAmount,CGSTAmount,VatAmount,SalesRate,Tax,TaxType,TaxPer,prid,FreeQuantity,Amount,DiscountAmount,DiscountPer)
	values(@SalesMasterId,@ItemId,@ItemBarCode,@ItemCode,@NetAmount,@Quantity,@CreatedBy,SYSDATETIME(),@BranchId,@ProductType,@Status,@TaxAmount,
	@IGSTAmount,@SGSTAmount,@CGSTAmount,@VatAmount,@SalesRate,@Tax,@TaxType,@TaxPer,@prid,@freequantity,@Amount,@DiscountAmount,@DiscountPer)

	
END

GO

	  begin

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[prdInsertAccountLedger]

@LedgerCode nvarchar(50),
@LedgerName nvarchar(50),
@AccountGroupId bigint,
@Telephone nvarchar(50),
@Mobile nvarchar(50),
@LedgerAddress nvarchar(50),
@TINNo nvarchar(50),
@EmailId nvarchar(50),
@Remarks nvarchar(max),
@DiscountPer decimal(18,2),
@CreditLimit decimal(18,2),
@CreditDays int,
@BranchId bigint,
@InterestPerDay decimal(18,2),
@BankId bigint,
@BankAccountNo nvarchar(50),
@BankBranch nvarchar(50),
@BankIFSC nvarchar(50),
@PAN nvarchar(50),
@GSTNo nvarchar(50),
@CompanyRegNo nvarchar(50),
@State nvarchar(50),
@CreatedBy bigint,
@CreatedDateTime datetime,
@Status int,
@Photo nvarchar(50),
@ICardNo nvarchar(50),
@Cardtype int,
@vfrom date,
@vto date,
@cardstatus int,
@Age int,
@Gender int,
@dob smalldatetime

As
Declare @Id bigint; 
Declare @Val varchar(50);
begin
    set @Val= (Select MAX(STUFF(LedgerCode, 1, PATINDEX('%[0-9]%', LedgerCode) - 1, '')) AS LedgerCode from tblAccountLedger);
	INSERT INTO tblAccountLedger(LedgerCode,LedgerName ,AccountGroupId,Telephone,Mobile,LedgerAddress,TINNo ,EmailId
	,Remarks,DiscountPer,CreditLimit,CreditDays,BranchId,InterestPerDay,BankId,BankAccountNo,BankBranch,BankIFSC,PAN,GSTNo
	,CompanyRegNo,[State],CreatedBy ,CreatedDateTime,[Status],Photo,ICardNo,cardtype,vfrom,vto,cardstatus,age,gender,dob)VALUES
	(@Val+1 ,@LedgerName,@AccountGroupId,@Telephone ,@Mobile,@LedgerAddress,@TINNo,@EmailId,@Remarks,@DiscountPer
	,@CreditLimit,@CreditDays,@BranchId,@InterestPerDay,@BankId,@BankAccountNo,@BankBranch,@BankIFSC ,@PAN,@GSTNo,@CompanyRegNo
    ,@State,@CreatedBy,@CreatedDateTime,@Status,@Photo,@ICardNo,@Cardtype,@vfrom,@vto,@cardstatus,@Age,@Gender,@dob)
End

Set @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY()
select @Id as LedgerId
GO

@CompanyId bigint,
@BranchCode nvarchar(50),
@BranchName nvarchar(50),
@BranchAddress nvarchar(50),
@PostalCode nvarchar(50),
@Telephone nvarchar(50),

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[prdInsertCardConsolAndTransfer]
@MasterLedgerId bigint,
@SubLedgerId bigint,
@TotCardBal decimal(10,2),
@TotCashBonBal decimal(10,2),
@TotBonPoint decimal(10,2),
@TotTokenBal decimal(10,2),
@TotLoyPoint decimal(10,2),
@CardBal decimal(10,2),
@CashBonBal decimal(10,2),
@BonPoint decimal(10,2),
@TokenBal decimal(10,2),
@LoyPoint decimal(10,2),
@FormType bigint,
@CreatedBy bigint,
@ModifiedBy bigint,
@BranchId bigint,
@Status bigint,
@ConsolidateId decimal,
@TransferId decimal
As
Begin

insert into tblCardConsoAndTransfer([MasterLedgerId],[SubLedgerId],[TotCardBal],[TotCashBonBal],
[TotBonPoint],[TotTokenBal],[TotLoyPoint],[CardBal],[CashBonBal],[BonPoint],[TokenBal],[LoyPoint],
[FormType],[CreatedBy],[CreatedOn],[BranchId],[Status],ConsolidateId,TransferId)
values(@MasterLedgerId,@SubLedgerId,@TotCardBal,@TotCashBonBal,@TotBonPoint,@TotTokenBal,@TotLoyPoint,
@CardBal,@CashBonBal,@BonPoint,@TokenBal,@LoyPoint,@FormType,@CreatedBy,SYSDATETIME(),@BranchId,@Status,@ConsolidateId,@TransferId)
End
update tblAccountLedger set CardBalance=CardBalance+@CardBal,CashBonusBalance=CashBonusBalance+@CashBonBal,
							TokenBalance=TokenBalance+@TokenBal,PointBalance=PointBalance+@BonPoint,loypoints=loypoints+@LoyPoint,ModifiedBy=@CreatedBy,ModifiedDateTime=SYSDATETIME() where LedgerId=@MasterLedgerId

update tblAccountLedger set CardBalance=CardBalance-@CardBal,CashBonusBalance=CashBonusBalance-@CashBonBal,
							TokenBalance=TokenBalance-@TokenBal,PointBalance=PointBalance-@BonPoint,loypoints=loypoints-@LoyPoint,ModifiedBy=@CreatedBy,ModifiedDateTime=SYSDATETIME() where LedgerId=@SubLedgerId

					
GO

 CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdInsertCardProducts]
@ProductId int,
@Product nvarchar(50),
@Description nvarchar(50),
@CategoryId int,
@DepartmentId int,
@SuggestedPrice decimal(18,2),
@CashBalance decimal(18,2),
@CashBonusBalance int,
@TokenBalance  bigint,
@Points decimal(18,2),
@MemberShipPremo nvarchar(50),
@BlockAccess int,
@LocationId nvarchar(50),
@Tax nvarchar(50),
@TaxTypeId int,
@TaxSettingsId int,
@CreatedBy bigint,
@BranchId decimal(18,2),
@Status int
AS

Declare @Id bigint; 
BEGIN
if(@ProductId=0)
begin
INSERT INTO  [dbo].[tblCardProducts]
           ([Product],	[Description],	[CategoryId],	[DepartmentId],	[SuggestedPrice],	[CashBalance],	[CashBonusBalnce],	[TokenBalnce],	[Points],	[MeberShipPremo],
	[BlockAccess],	[LocationId],	[Status],	[Tax],	[TaxTypeId], [TaxSettingsId],	[CreatedBy],	[CreatedOn],	[BranchId])
     VALUES			(@Product,@Description,@CategoryId,@DepartmentId,@SuggestedPrice,@CashBalance,@CashBonusBalance,@TokenBalance,
@Points,@MemberShipPremo,@BlockAccess,@LocationId,@Status,@Tax,@TaxTypeId,@TaxSettingsId,@CreatedBy,SYSDATETIME(),@BranchId)

Set @ProductId =SCOPE_IDENTITY()
end
else
begin

 where Product_id=@ProductId

select @ProductId as ProductId

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdInsertDrawer]
@Id int,
@DName  varchar(max),
@InitilAmount  decimal(10,2),
@LoanAmount decimal(10,2),
@Status int,
@BranchId INT,
@CreatedBy int,
@Drops decimal(10,2),
@EmployeeId int
AS
Declare @Did bigint;
BEGIN
if @Id>0
	begin
		update tblDrawerAssign set BranchId=@BranchId,LoanAmount = LoanAmount + @LoanAmount,Drops=Drops + @Drops,ModifiedDateTime=SYSDATETIME(),Status=@Status,EmployeeId=@EmployeeId
		where  Id=@Id
		SELECT @Did  as Id
	end
	
else
	begin

		Insert into tblDrawerAssign(DName,InitilAmount,LoanAmount,CreatedBy,CreatedDateTime,BranchId,Drops,Status,EmployeeId)values(@DName,@InitilAmount,@LoanAmount,@CreatedBy,SYSDATETIME(),@BranchId,@Drops,@Status,@EmployeeId)	
		Set @Did=SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	end
	SELECT @Did  as Id
END

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[prdInsertFinancialYear]
@Description nvarchar(50),
@FromDate date,
@ToDate date,
@Remarks nvarchar(50),
@Status int,
@CreatedBy bigint

As 
Begin
Declare @Id bigint; 
insert into tblFinancialYear ([Description],FromDate,ToDate,Remarks,[Status],CreatedBy)
values(@Description,@FromDate,@ToDate,@Remarks,@Status,@CreatedBy)
if @Status=0
begin

set @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY()
update tblGeneralOptions set GTypeSubText1=@Id,GTypeSubText2=@Description where GTypeId=(select GTypeId from tblGType where GType='FINANCIAL YEAR')
update tblFinancialYear set [Status]=1 where FinancialYearId<>@Id
end 
End

    if @Id!=0
	begin
	update tblGameOffer set EntryDate=SYSDATETIME(),fDt=@fDt,tDt=@tDt,OfferDesc=@OfferDesc,DiscPer=@Discper,VIPDiscPer=@VIPDiscPer,ModifiedBy=@CreatedBy,Status=@Status,Remarks=@Remark,BranchId=@BranchID,MembId=@MembId,ModifiedDateTime=SYSDATETIME() where id=@Id;
	set @OfferId=@Id
	end
	else
	begin
	insert into tblGameOffer(EntryDate,fDt,tDt,OfferDesc,DiscPer,VIPDiscPer,CreatedBy,Status,Remarks,BranchId,MembId,CreatedDateTime)
	values(SYSDATETIME(),@fDt,@tDt,@OfferDesc,@Discper,@Discper,@CreatedBy,@Status,@Remark,@BranchID,@MembId,SYSDATETIME());
	set @OfferId=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
	end
	SELECT @OfferId  as Id
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdInsertGameOfferMapping]
@ID int,
@gmid int,
@OfferId int,
@Status int,
@BranchId int
AS
Declare @Count int
BEGIN
	Select @Count=Count(*)from tblGameOfferMapping where gmid=@gmid and offerid=@OfferId
	if(@Count>0)
	begin
	update tblGameOfferMapping set status=@Status  where gmid=@gmid and offerid=@OfferId
	end
	else
	begin
	insert into tblGameOfferMapping(gmid,OfferId,Status)values(@gmid,@OfferId,@Status)
	end
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdInsertGroupSaleDetails]
@BulkId int,
@Product int,
@ProductName varchar(100),
@ICardNo varchar(max),
@ProductCategory int,
@CardBalance decimal,
@CashBonusBalance decimal,
@TokenBalance decimal,
@PointBalance decimal,
@TimePlayDur decimal,
@GatePassDur decimal,
@TrampolineDur decimal,
@Price decimal,
@Tax varchar(50),
@TaxsettingId int,
@TaxType varchar(10),
@TaxPer decimal,
@TaxAmt decimal,
@NetAmt decimal,
@Name varchar(100),
@Flage int
AS
declare @count int,@Id int;
BEGIN
select  @count=COUNT(*) from tblGroupSaleDetails where BulkId=BulkId and Product=@Product
if @count=0
begin
	update tblGroupSaleDetails set Status=0 where BulkId=BulkId and Product=@Product
end


insert into tblGroupSaleDetails
(BulkId,Product,ICardNo,Status,ProductCategory,Tax,TaxSettingsId,CardBalance,CashBonusBalance,
TokenBalance,PointBalance,TimePlayDur,GatePassDur,TrampolineDur,ProductName,Price,TaxType,
TaxPer,TaxAmt,NetAmt)
values(@BulkId,@Product,@ICardNo,1,@ProductCategory,@Tax,@TaxsettingId,@CardBalance,@CashBonusBalance,
@TokenBalance,@PointBalance,@TimePlayDur,@GatePassDur,@TrampolineDur,@ProductName,@Price,@TaxType,
@TaxPer,@TaxAmt,@NetAmt)
Set @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
if @Flage <>0
begin
	set @Name=@Name+CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @Id);
end
update tblGroupSaleDetails set Name=@Name where Id=@Id;
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdInsertInward]
@EType int,
@EntryNo nvarchar(50),
@EntryDate smalldatetime,
@DocumentNo nvarchar(50),
@LedgerId bigint,
@InwAddress nvarchar(50),
@PaymentMode int,
@Telephone nvarchar(50),
@Remarks nvarchar(50),
@TotalGross decimal(18,2),
@TotalAmount decimal(18,2),
@TotalDiscount decimal(18,2),
@TotalTax decimal(18,2),
@TotalIGST decimal(18,2),
@TotalCGST decimal(18,2),
@TotalSGST decimal(18,2),
@DiscountPer decimal(18,2),
@DiscountAmount decimal(18,2),
@AmountAdjust decimal(18,2),
@NetAmount decimal(18,2),
@TransportNo bigint,
@CreditDays int,
@DueDate date,
@DocumentType nvarchar(max),
@BranchId bigint,
@FinancialYearId bigint,
@TotalQuantity bigint,
@DocumentDate date,
@TotalNetAmount decimal(18,2),
@TotalMiscCharges decimal(18,2),
@TotalCess decimal(18,2),
@CreatedBy bigint,
@Status int,
@fromid int
AS
declare @currdate datetime
    /**set @currdate = convert(varchar, getdate(), 120)*/
	set @currdate = getdate()

Declare @Id bigint; 

DECLARE @Serial TABLE( InwardSrlNo BIGINT )

BEGIN
UPDATE tblBranch SET InwardSrlNo=InwardSrlNo+1 
OUTPUT inserted.InwardSrlNo INTO @Serial 
where BranchId =@BranchId
 END
BEGIN
INSERT INTO tblInward
           ([EType]
           ,[EntryNo]
           ,[EntryDate]
           ,[DocumentNo]
           ,[LedgerId]
           ,[InwAddress]
           ,[PaymentMode]
           ,[Telephone]
           ,[Remarks]
           ,[TotalGross]
           ,[TotalAmount]
           ,[TotalDiscount]
		   ,[TotalTax]
           ,[TotalIGST]
           ,[TotalCGST]
           ,[TotalSGST]
           ,[DiscountPer]
           ,[DiscountAmount]
		   ,[AmountAdjust]
           ,[NetAmount]
           ,[TransportNo]
           ,[CreditDays]
           ,[DueDate]
           ,[DocumentType]
           ,[BranchId]
           ,[FinancialYearId]
           ,[TotalQuantity]
           ,[DocumentDate]
           ,[TotalNetAmount]
		   ,[TotalMiscCharges]
		   ,[TotalCess]
           ,[CreatedBy]
		   ,[CreatedDateTime]
           ,[Status]
		   ,[fromid])
     VALUES
           (@EType,
			(select InwardSrlNo FROM @Serial),
			@EntryDate,
			@DocumentNo,
			@LedgerId,
			@InwAddress,
			@PaymentMode,
			@Telephone,
			@Remarks,
			@TotalGross,
			@TotalAmount,
			@TotalDiscount,
			@TotalTax,
			@TotalIGST,
			@TotalCGST,
			@TotalSGST,
			@DiscountPer,
			@DiscountAmount,
			@AmountAdjust,
			@NetAmount,
			@TransportNo,
			@CreditDays,
			@DueDate,
			@DocumentType,
			@BranchId,
			@FinancialYearId,
			@TotalQuantity,
			@DocumentDate,
			@TotalNetAmount,
			@TotalMiscCharges,
			@TotalCess,
			@CreatedBy,
			@currdate,
			@Status,
			@fromid) 
Set @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY()
select @Id as InwardMasterId
END
GO

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[prdInsertInwDetails] 
@InwardMasterId bigint,@PMDocumentNo nvarchar(50),@ItemId bigint ,@ItemCode nvarchar(50),@ItemBarCode nvarchar(50),@UnitId bigint,@Quantity decimal(18,2)
,@FreeQuantity decimal(18,2) ,@PurchaseRate decimal(18,2),@IRate decimal(18,2),@Amount decimal(18,2),@DiscountPer decimal(18,2),
@DiscountAmount decimal(18,2),@IGSTAmount decimal(18,2),@CGSTAmount decimal(18,2),@SGSTAmount decimal(18,2),@GrossAmount decimal(18,2),
@TaxPer decimal(18,2),@TaxAmount decimal(18,2),@CessPer decimal(18,2),@CessAmount  decimal(18,2),@NetAmount decimal(18,2),
@BranchId bigint,@FinancialYearId bigint,@TaxType bigint,@Cost decimal(18,2),@Margin decimal(18,2),
@MRP decimal(18,2),
@QuantitytoSubtract bigint,
@StockItem bigint,@CreatedBy bigint,@Status int
As 
declare @currdate datetime
    /**set @currdate = convert(varchar, getdate(), 120)*/
	set @currdate = getdate()

Begin
Declare @TranStatus int;
begin Transaction T
begin try
begin
INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblInwDetails]
           ([InwardMasterId]
		   ,[PMDocumentNo]
           ,[ItemId]
           ,[ItemCode]
           ,[ItemBarCode]
           ,[UnitId]
           ,[Quantity]
           ,[FreeQuantity]
           ,[PurchaseRate]
           ,[IRate]
           ,[Amount]
           ,[DiscountPer]
           ,[DiscountAmount]
           ,[IGSTAmount]
           ,[CGSTAmount]
           ,[SGSTAmount]
           ,[GrossAmount]
		   ,[TaxPer]
           ,[TaxAmount]
		   ,[CessPer]
		   ,[CessAmount]
           ,[NetAmount]
           ,[BranchId]
           ,[FinancialYearId]
           ,[TaxType]
           ,[Cost]
           ,[Margin]
           ,[MRP]
           ,[CreatedBy]  
		   ,[CreatedDateTime]
           ,[Status]
		    )
     VALUES(@InwardMasterId,@PMDocumentNo,@ItemId,@ItemCode,@ItemBarCode,@UnitId,@Quantity,@FreeQuantity,@PurchaseRate,@IRate,@Amount,@DiscountPer,
	 @DiscountAmount,@IGSTAmount,@CGSTAmount,@SGSTAmount,@GrossAmount,@TaxPer,@TaxAmount,@CessPer,@CessAmount,@NetAmount,@BranchId,@FinancialYearId,@TaxType,@Cost,@Margin,
	 @MRP,@CreatedBy,@currdate,@Status)
	 end
	 if (@StockItem=1)
	Begin
	update [dbo].tblItem set QuantityOnHand = QuantityOnHand + (@QuantitytoSubtract*@Quantity) WHERE ItemId = @ItemId
	End 
end try
	begin catch
	set @TranStatus=0
	rollback Transaction T
	Select @TranStatus
	return
	end catch
commit transaction T
end
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdInsertItem_otherBranch]

@ItemId bigint,
@BranchId bigint
AS
BEGIN

declare @currdate datetime
    /**set @currdate = convert(varchar, getdate(), 120)*/
	set @currdate = getdate()

INSERT INTO dbo.tblItem ( BranchId, ItemCode, BarcodeMode, Barcode, ItemName, BrandName, SearchName, CategoryId, PacketQty, CGSTPer, SGSTPer, IGSTPer, CessPer, SalesTaxIncl, PurchaseTaxIncl, ManufactureId, Rack, SellingPer, MainUnitId, PurchaseRate1, MRP1, SubUnitId, PurchaseRate2, MRP2, HSNCode, [Image], TaxType, LastSellingPer1, LastPurchaseRate1, LastMRP1, LastSellingPer, LastPurchaseRate2, LastMRP2, StockItem, LockSaleRate, ItemClassId, ExpiryDate, Remarks, OtherTaxPer, CreatedBy, CreatedDateTime, ModifiedBy, ModifiedDateTime, Status, SaleRate, SubSaleRate, LastSaleRate, LastSubSaleRate )
SELECT @BranchId AS Expr1, dbo.tblItem.ItemCode, dbo.tblItem.BarcodeMode, dbo.tblItem.Barcode, dbo.tblItem.ItemName, dbo.tblItem.BrandName, dbo.tblItem.SearchName, dbo.tblItem.CategoryId, dbo.tblItem.PacketQty, dbo.tblItem.CGSTPer, dbo.tblItem.SGSTPer, dbo.tblItem.IGSTPer, dbo.tblItem.CessPer, dbo.tblItem.SalesTaxIncl, dbo.tblItem.PurchaseTaxIncl, dbo.tblItem.ManufactureId, dbo.tblItem.Rack, dbo.tblItem.SellingPer, dbo.tblItem.MainUnitId, dbo.tblItem.PurchaseRate1, dbo.tblItem.MRP1, dbo.tblItem.SubUnitId, dbo.tblItem.PurchaseRate2, dbo.tblItem.MRP2, dbo.tblItem.HSNCode, dbo.tblItem.Image, dbo.tblItem.TaxType, dbo.tblItem.LastSellingPer1, dbo.tblItem.LastPurchaseRate1, dbo.tblItem.LastMRP1, dbo.tblItem.LastSellingPer, dbo.tblItem.LastPurchaseRate2, dbo.tblItem.LastMRP2, dbo.tblItem.StockItem, dbo.tblItem.LockSaleRate, dbo.tblItem.ItemClassId, dbo.tblItem.ExpiryDate, dbo.tblItem.Remarks, dbo.tblItem.OtherTaxPer, dbo.tblItem.CreatedBy, @currdate , dbo.tblItem.ModifiedBy, @currdate , dbo.tblItem.Status, dbo.tblItem.SaleRate, dbo.tblItem.SubSaleRate, dbo.tblItem.LastSaleRate, dbo.tblItem.LastSubSaleRate
FROM dbo.tblItem
WHERE (((dbo.tblItem.ItemId)=@ItemId));
 END

create PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdInsertJournal]

@EntryNo int,
@EntryDate DateTime,
@ByToId int,
@ByAccId int,
@ByDrAmt decimal,
@ToAccId int,
@ToCrAmt decimal,
@Narr varchar(100),
@CreatedBy  int,
@Status int,
@BranchId int
AS
BEGIN
declare @count int;
set @count=(select COUNT(*) from tblJournal where EntryNo=@EntryNo);
if @count >0
begin
update tblJournal set EntryDate=@EntryDate,ByToId=@ByToId,ByAccId=@ByAccId,ByDrAmt=@ByDrAmt,ToAccId=@ToAccId,ToCrAmt=@ToCrAmt,Narr=@Narr,ModifiedBy=@CreatedBy,ModifiedDateTime=SYSDATETIME(),Status=@Status where EntryNo=@EntryNo;
	end
else
begin 
insert into tblJournal(EntryNo,EntryDate,ByToId,ByAccId,ByDrAmt,ToAccId,ToCrAmt,Narr,CreatedBy,CreatedDateTime,Status,BranchId)
	values(@EntryNo,@EntryDate,@ByToId,@ByAccId,@ByDrAmt,@ToAccId,@ToCrAmt,@Narr,@CreatedBy,SYSDATETIME(),@Status,@BranchId);

end

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PrdInsertMemberShipDayMapping]
@MembId int,
@DayId int,
@status int
AS
Declare @Count int
BEGIN
	Select @Count=Count(*)from tblMemberShipDayMapping where MembId=@MembId and DayId=@DayId  
	if (@Count >0)
	begin
	Update tblMemberShipDayMapping set status=@status where MembId=@MembId and DayId=@DayId;
	end	
	else
	begin
	insert into tblMemberShipDayMapping(MembId,DayId,Status)
	values(@MembId,@DayId,@status);
	end
	
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdInsertOutward]

@EType int,
@EntryNo nvarchar(50),
@EntryDate date,
@DocumentNo nvarchar(50),
@LedgerId bigint,
@oAddress nvarchar(50),
@PaymentMode int,
@Telephone nvarchar(50),
@Remarks nvarchar(50),
@TotalGross decimal(18,2),
@TotalAmount decimal(18,2),
@TotalDiscount decimal(18,2),
@TotalTax decimal(18,2),
@TotalIGST decimal(18,2),
@TotalCGST decimal(18,2),
@TotalSGST decimal(18,2),
@DiscountPer decimal(18,2),
@DiscountAmount decimal(18,2),
@AmountAdjust decimal(18,2),
@NetAmount decimal(18,2),
@TransportNo bigint,
@CreditDays int,
@DueDate date,
@DocumentType nvarchar(max),
@BranchId bigint,
@FinancialYearId bigint,
@TotalQuantity bigint,
@DocumentDate date,
@TotalNetAmount decimal(18,2),
@TotalMiscCharges decimal(18,2),
@TotalCess decimal(18,2),
@CreatedBy bigint,
@Status int,
@toid int
AS
declare @currdate datetime
    /**set @currdate = convert(varchar, getdate(), 120)*/
	set @currdate = getdate()

Declare @Id bigint; 

DECLARE @Serial TABLE( OutwardSrlNo BIGINT )


BEGIN
UPDATE tblBranch SET OutwardSrlNo=OutwardSrlNo+1 
OUTPUT inserted.OutwardSrlNo INTO @Serial 
where BranchId =@BranchId
 END
BEGIN
INSERT INTO tblOutward
           ([EType]
           ,[EntryNo]
           ,[EntryDate]
           ,[DocumentNo]
           ,[LedgerId]
           ,[oAddress]
           ,[PaymentMode]
           ,[Telephone]
           ,[Remarks]
           ,[TotalGross]
           ,[TotalAmount]
           ,[TotalDiscount]
		   ,[TotalTax]
           ,[TotalIGST]
           ,[TotalCGST]
           ,[TotalSGST]
           ,[DiscountPer]
           ,[DiscountAmount]
		   ,[AmountAdjust]
           ,[NetAmount]
           ,[TransportNo]
           ,[CreditDays]
           ,[DueDate]
           ,[DocumentType]
           ,[BranchId]
           ,[FinancialYearId]
           ,[TotalQuantity]
           ,[DocumentDate]
           ,[TotalNetAmount]
		   ,[TotalMiscCharges]
		   ,[TotalCess]
           ,[CreatedBy]
		   ,[CreatedDateTime]
           ,[Status]
		   ,[Toid])
     VALUES
           (@EType,
			(select OutwardSrlNo FROM @Serial),
			@EntryDate,
			@DocumentNo,
			@LedgerId,
			@oAddress,
			@PaymentMode,
			@Telephone,
			@Remarks,
			@TotalGross,
			@TotalAmount,
			@TotalDiscount,
			@TotalTax,
			@TotalIGST,
			@TotalCGST,
			@TotalSGST,
			@DiscountPer,
			@DiscountAmount,
			@AmountAdjust,
			@NetAmount,
			@TransportNo,
			@CreditDays,
			@DueDate,
			@DocumentType,
			@BranchId,
			@FinancialYearId,
			@TotalQuantity,
			@DocumentDate,
			@TotalNetAmount,
			@TotalMiscCharges,
			@TotalCess,
			@CreatedBy,
			@currdate,
			@Status,
			@toid) 
Set @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY()
select @Id as OutwardId
END

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[prdInsertOutwardDetails] 
@OutwardId bigint,@InDocumentNo nvarchar(50),@ItemId bigint ,@ItemCode nvarchar(50),@ItemBarCode nvarchar(50),@UnitId bigint,@Quantity decimal(18,2)
,@FreeQuantity decimal(18,2) ,@PurchaseRate decimal(18,2),@IRate decimal(18,2),@Amount decimal(18,2),@DiscountPer decimal(18,2),
@DiscountAmount decimal(18,2),@IGSTAmount decimal(18,2),@CGSTAmount decimal(18,2),@SGSTAmount decimal(18,2),@GrossAmount decimal(18,2),
@TaxPer decimal(18,2),@TaxAmount decimal(18,2),@CessPer decimal(18,2),@CessAmount  decimal(18,2),@NetAmount decimal(18,2),
@BranchId bigint,@FinancialYearId bigint,@TaxType bigint,@Isrno decimal(18,2),@Cost decimal(18,2),@Margin decimal(18,2),
@MRP decimal(18,2),
@QuantitytoSubtract bigint,
@StockItem bigint,@CreatedBy bigint,@Status int
As 
declare @currdate datetime
    /**set @currdate = convert(varchar, getdate(), 120)*/
	set @currdate = getdate()

Begin
Declare @TranStatus int;
begin Transaction T
begin try
begin
INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblOutwardDetails]
           ([OutwardId]
		   ,[InDocumentNo]
           ,[ItemId]
           ,[ItemCode]
           ,[ItemBarCode]
           ,[UnitId]
           ,[Quantity]
           ,[FreeQuantity]
           ,[PurchaseRate]
           ,[IRate]
           ,[Amount]
           ,[DiscountPer]
           ,[DiscountAmount]
           ,[IGSTAmount]
           ,[CGSTAmount]
           ,[SGSTAmount]
           ,[GrossAmount]
		   ,[TaxPer]
           ,[TaxAmount]
		   ,[CessPer]
		   ,[CessAmount]
           ,[NetAmount]
           ,[BranchId]
           ,[FinancialYearId]
           ,[TaxType]
           ,[Cost]
           ,[Margin]
           ,[MRP]
           ,[CreatedBy]    
		   ,[CreatedDateTime]      
           ,[Status]
		    )
     VALUES(@OutwardId,@InDocumentNo,@ItemId,@ItemCode,@ItemBarCode,@UnitId,@Quantity,@FreeQuantity,@PurchaseRate,@IRate,@Amount,@DiscountPer,
	 @DiscountAmount,@IGSTAmount,@CGSTAmount,@SGSTAmount,@GrossAmount,@TaxPer,@TaxAmount,@CessPer,@CessAmount,@NetAmount,@BranchId,@FinancialYearId,@TaxType,@Cost,@Margin,
	 @MRP,@CreatedBy,@currdate,@Status)
	 end
	 if (@StockItem=1)
	Begin
	update [dbo].tblItem set QuantityOnHand = QuantityOnHand + (@QuantitytoSubtract*@Quantity) WHERE ItemId = @ItemId
	End 
end try
	begin catch
	set @TranStatus=0
	rollback Transaction T
	Select @TranStatus
	return
	end catch
commit transaction T
end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdInsertProduction]
@ProdID int,
@EntryNo int,
@EntryDate datetime,
@ProdDate datetime,
@PackDate datetime,
@ProdName varchar(max),
@BarCode varchar(50),
@BatchCode varchar(50),
@ExpDate datetime,
@ProdQty decimal,
@ItemId int,
@ItemCode varchar(50),
@CategoryId int,
@UnitId int,
@sRate decimal,
@MRP decimal,
@Amt decimal,
@TotalQty decimal,
@TotalAmount decimal,
@TotalExtraAmount decimal,
@CostperQty decimal,
@ProdCost decimal,
@TotCost decimal,
@NetAmount decimal,
@Remark varchar(50),
@BranchId int,
@CreatedBy varchar(50),
@ModifiedBy varchar(50),
@FinancialYearId int,
@Status int
AS

Declare @Id bigint;
BEGIN

	DECLARE @StockItem INT
	set @StockItem=(SELECT isnull(StockItem,0) AS StockItem FROM [dbo].tblItem WHERE [dbo].tblItem.ItemId =@ItemId)
	/*if EXISTS(select * from tblProduction where Productionid=@ProdID)*/
if @ProdID>0
	begin
		update tblProduction set EntryNo=@EntryNo ,
								EntryDate =@EntryDate ,
								ProdDate=@ProdDate ,
								PackDate=@PackDate ,
								ProdName=@ProdName,
								BarCode=@BarCode ,
								BatchCode=@BatchCode,
								ExpDate=@ExpDate ,
								ProdQty=@ProdQty,
								ItemId=@ItemId ,
								ItemCode=@ItemCode,
								CategoryId=@CategoryId,
								UnitId=@UnitId,
								sRate=@sRate ,
								MRP=@MRP ,
								Amt=@Amt ,
								TotalQty=@TotalQty ,
								TotalAmount=@TotalAmount ,
								TotalExtraAmount=@TotalExtraAmount ,
								CostperQty=@CostperQty ,
								ProdCost=@ProdCost ,
								TotCost=@TotCost ,
								NetAmount=@NetAmount ,
								Remark=@Remark ,
								BranchId=@BranchId ,
								CreatedBy=@CreatedBy ,
								ModifiedBy=@ModifiedBy ,
								ModifiedDateTime=SYSDATETIME(),
								FinancialYearId =@FinancialYearId ,
								[Status]=@Status where Productionid=@ProdID

								/*select Productionid from tblProduction where Productionid=@ProdID*/
								  SELECT @Id= @ProdID
	end
else
	begin
		UPDATE tblBranch SET ProdSrNo=isnull(ProdSrNo,0)+1 where BranchId=@BranchId

		insert into tblProduction(EntryNo ,EntryDate ,ProdDate ,PackDate ,ProdName ,BarCode ,BatchCode ,ExpDate ,ProdQty ,ItemId ,ItemCode ,CategoryId ,
		UnitId ,sRate ,MRP ,Amt ,TotalQty ,TotalAmount ,TotalExtraAmount ,CostperQty ,ProdCost ,TotCost ,NetAmount ,Remark ,
		BranchId ,CreatedBy ,CreatedDateTime,FinancialYearId ,[Status] )

		values(@EntryNo ,@EntryDate ,@ProdDate ,@PackDate ,@ProdName ,@BarCode ,@BatchCode ,@ExpDate ,@ProdQty ,@ItemId ,
		@ItemCode ,@CategoryId ,@UnitId ,@sRate ,@MRP ,@Amt ,@TotalQty ,@TotalAmount ,@TotalExtraAmount ,@CostperQty ,@ProdCost ,
		@TotCost ,@NetAmount ,@Remark ,@BranchId ,@CreatedBy ,SYSDATETIME(),@FinancialYearId ,@Status );

		if (@StockItem=1)
		Begin
			update [dbo].tblItem set QuantityOnHand = isnull(QuantityOnHand,0) + (@ProdQty) WHERE ItemId = @ItemId
		End 

		Set @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY()
		/*select @Id as Prodid*/
		
	end
	select @Id as Prodid
RETURN (select Productionid as Prodid from tblProduction where Productionid=@ID)

END

GO

 CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdInsertPurchase]
--Purchase Master
@EType int,@EntryNo nvarchar(50),@EntryDate smalldatetime,
@DocumentNo nvarchar(50),@LedgerId bigint,@PurchaseAddress nvarchar(50),
@PaymentMode int,@Telephone nvarchar(50),@Remarks nvarchar(50),
@TotalGross decimal(18,2),@TotalAmount decimal(18,2),@TotalDiscount decimal(18,2),
@TotalIGST decimal(18,2),@TotalCGST decimal(18,2),@TotalSGST decimal(18,2),
@OtherDeduction decimal(18,2),@DiscountPer decimal(18,2),@DiscountAmount decimal(18,2),
@OtherAdditions decimal(18,2),@NetAmount decimal(18,2),@PaidAmount decimal(18,2),
@BalanceAmount decimal(18,2),@EmployeeId bigint,@OtherAddionDesc nvarchar(50),
@OtherDeductionDesc nvarchar(50),@TransportNo nvarchar(50),@AdminId bigint,
@CreditDays int,@DueDate date,@DocumentType nvarchar(max),
@BranchId bigint,@FinancialYearId bigint,@TotalQuantity bigint,
@SalesTerms nvarchar(50),@DocumentDate date,@TotalNetAmount decimal(18,2),
--Purchase Details
@PurchaseMasterId bigint,@ItemId bigint ,@ItemCode bigint,
@ItemBarCode nvarchar(50),@UnitId bigint,@Quantity decimal(18,2),
@FreeQuantity decimal(18,2) ,@PurchaseRate decimal(18,2),@IRate decimal(18,2),
@Amount decimal(18,2),@ItemDiscountPer decimal(18,2),@ItemDiscountAmount decimal(18,2),
@IGSTAmount decimal(18,2),@CGSTAmount decimal(18,2),@SGSTAmount decimal(18,2),
@GrossAmount decimal(18,2),@TaxAmount decimal(18,2),@ItemNetAmount decimal(18,2),
@TaxType bigint,@Cost decimal(18,2),@Margin decimal(18,2),@MRP decimal(18,2),
--Purchase Miscellaneous
@GeneralId bigint,@MiscAmount decimal(18,2),
@CreatedBy bigint,@Status int
as 
begin
Declare @TranStatus int;
begin Transaction T
	begin try
	Declare @Id bigint; 

	--Purchase Master Save
	exec @Id=prdInsertPurchaseMaster 
	@EType,@EntryNo,@EntryDate,@DocumentNo,@LedgerId,@PurchaseAddress,@PaymentMode,@Telephone,@Remarks,
	@TotalGross,@TotalAmount,@TotalDiscount,@TotalIGST,@TotalCGST,@TotalSGST,@OtherDeduction,
	@DiscountPer,@DiscountAmount,@OtherAdditions,@NetAmount,@PaidAmount,@BalanceAmount,@EmployeeId,@OtherAddionDesc,
	@OtherDeductionDesc,@TransportNo,@AdminId,@CreditDays,@DueDate,@DocumentType,@BranchId,@FinancialYearId,@TotalQuantity,
	@SalesTerms,@DocumentDate,@TotalNetAmount,@CreatedBy,@Status

	--Purchase Details Save
	exec prdInsertPurchaseDetails @Id,@ItemId,@ItemCode,@ItemBarCode,@UnitId,@Quantity,@FreeQuantity,@PurchaseRate,@IRate,@Amount,@ItemDiscountPer,
	@ItemDiscountAmount,@IGSTAmount,@CGSTAmount,@SGSTAmount,@GrossAmount,@TaxAmount,@ItemNetAmount,@BranchId,@FinancialYearId,@TaxType,@Cost,@Margin,
	@MRP,@CreatedBy,@Status

	--Purchase Misc Save
	exec prdInsertPurchaseMiscCharges @Id,@GeneralId,@MiscAmount,@CreatedBy,@Status
	Update tblBranch SET PurchaseSrlNo = PurchaseSrlNo+1 WHERE BranchId=@BranchId;
	set @TranStatus=1
	end try

	begin catch
	set @TranStatus=0
	rollback Transaction T
	Select @TranStatus
	return
	end catch
commit transaction T
Select @TranStatus
return;
end

		   ,[ExpDate])
     VALUES(@PurchaseMasterId,@ItemId,@ItemCode,@ItemBarCode,@UnitId,@Quantity,@FreeQuantity,@PurchaseRate,@IRate,@Amount,@DiscountPer,
	 @DiscountAmount,@IGSTAmount,@CGSTAmount,@SGSTAmount,@GrossAmount,@TaxPer,@TaxAmount,@CessPer,@CessAmount,@NetAmount,@BranchId,@FinancialYearId,@TaxType,@Cost,@Margin,
	 @MRP,@CreatedBy,@currdate,@Status,@ExpDate)
	 end
	 if (@StockItem=1)
	Begin
	update [dbo].tblItem set QuantityOnHand = QuantityOnHand + (@QuantitytoSubtract*@Quantity) WHERE ItemId = @ItemId
	End 
end try
	begin catch
	set @TranStatus=0
	rollback Transaction T
	Select @TranStatus
	return
	end catch
commit transaction T
end
