 CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdInsertPurchaseReturnDetails]
@PurchaseReturnMasterId bigint,@PMDocumentNo nvarchar(50), @ItemId bigint ,@ItemCode nvarchar(50),@ItemBarCode nvarchar(50),@UnitId bigint,@Quantity decimal(18,2)
,@FreeQuantity decimal(18,2) ,@PurchaseRate decimal(18,2),@IRate decimal(18,2),@Amount decimal(18,2),@DiscountPer decimal(18,2),
@DiscountAmount decimal(18,2),@IGSTAmount decimal(18,2),@CGSTAmount decimal(18,2),@SGSTAmount decimal(18,2),@GrossAmount decimal(18,2),
@TaxPer decimal(18,2),@TaxAmount decimal(18,2),@CessPer decimal(18,2),@CessAmount  decimal(18,2),@NetAmount decimal(18,2),
@BranchId bigint,@FinancialYearId bigint,@TaxType bigint,@Cost decimal(18,2),@Margin decimal(18,2),
@MRP decimal(18,2),
@QuantitytoSubtract bigint,
@StockItem bigint,@CreatedBy bigint,@Status int
As 
declare @currdate smalldatetime
    /**set @currdate = convert(varchar, getdate(), 120)*/
	set @currdate =  SYSDATETIME()


Begin
Declare @TranStatus int;
begin Transaction T
begin try
begin
INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblPurchaseReturnDetails]
           ([PurchaseReturnMasterId]
		   ,[PMDocumentNo]
           ,[ItemId]
           ,[ItemCode]
           ,[ItemBarCode]
		   ,[HSNCode]
           ,[UnitId]
           ,[Quantity]
           ,[FreeQuantity]
           ,[PurchaseRate]
           ,[IRate]
           ,[Amount]
           ,[DiscountPer]
           ,[DiscountAmount]
           ,[IGSTAmount]
           ,[CGSTAmount]
           ,[SGSTAmount]
           ,[GrossAmount]
		   ,[TaxPer]
           ,[TaxAmount]
		   ,[CessPer]
		   ,[CessAmount]
           ,[NetAmount]
           ,[BranchId]
           ,[FinancialYearId]
           ,[TaxType]
           ,[Cost]
           ,[Margin]
           ,[MRP]
           ,[CreatedBy]          
		   ,[CreatedDateTime]
           ,[Status])
     VALUES(
	 @PurchaseReturnMasterId,
	 @PMDocumentNo,
	 @ItemId,@ItemCode,
	 @ItemBarCode,
	 (select HSNCode From tblItem Where ItemId=@ItemId),

	 @UnitId,
	 @Quantity,
	 @FreeQuantity,
	 @PurchaseRate,
	 @IRate,@Amount,
	 @DiscountPer,
	 @DiscountAmount,
	 @IGSTAmount,
	 @CGSTAmount,
	 @SGSTAmount,
	 @GrossAmount,
	 @TaxPer,
	 @TaxAmount,
	 @CessPer,
	 @CessAmount,
	 @NetAmount,
	 @BranchId,
	 @FinancialYearId,
	 @TaxType,
	 @Cost,
	 @Margin,
	 @MRP,
	 @CreatedBy,
	 @currdate,
	 @Status)
	 end
	 if (@StockItem=1)
	Begin
	update [dbo].tblItem set QuantityOnHand = QuantityOnHand - (@QuantitytoSubtract*@Quantity) WHERE ItemId = @ItemId
	End 
end try
	begin catch
	set @TranStatus=0
	rollback Transaction T
	Select @TranStatus
	return
	end catch
commit transaction T

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdInsertReaderDisplayProfile]
@ProfileId int,
@ProfileName varchar(50),
@Lable varchar(50),
@Text varchar(100),
@FontSize int,
@FontColor varchar(50),
@X int,
@Y int,
@Status int
AS
BEGIN
declare @count int;
 set @count=(select COUNT(*)from tblReaderDisplayProfiles where ProfileId=@ProfileId and status=1 and Lable=@Lable);
	if(@count>0)
	begin
	update tblReaderDisplayProfiles set Text=@text,FontSize=@FontSize,FontColor=@FontColor,X=@X,Y=@Y,Status=@Status,ProfileName=@ProfileName where ProfileId=@ProfileId and status=1 and Lable=@Lable;
	end

	values(@ProfileName,@Lable,@Text,@FontSize,@FontColor,@X,@Y,@Status,@ProfileId)
	end
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdInsertRePackProduct]
@ProdID int,
@EntryNo int,
@EntryDate datetime,
@PackDate datetime,
@ItemId int,
@ItemCode varchar(50),
@BarCode varchar(50),
@BatchCode varchar(50),
@ExpDate datetime,
@Qty decimal,
@UnitId int,
@pRate decimal,
@sRate decimal,
@MRP decimal,
@Amt decimal,
@TotalQty decimal,
@TotalAmount decimal,
@TotalPackQtyWt decimal,
@TotalPack decimal,
@TotalDenoQty decimal,
@BalQty decimal,
@Remark varchar(50),
@BranchId int,
@CreatedBy varchar(50),
@ModifiedBy varchar(50),
@FinancialYearId int,
@Status int
AS

Declare @Id bigint;
BEGIN

	DECLARE @StockItem INT
	set @StockItem=(SELECT isnull(StockItem,0) AS StockItem FROM [dbo].tblItem WHERE [dbo].tblItem.ItemId =@ItemId)
	/*if EXISTS(select * from tblProduction where Productionid=@ProdID)*/
if @ProdID>0
	begin
		update tblRePackProduct set EntryNo=@EntryNo ,
								EntryDate =@EntryDate ,
								PackDate=@PackDate ,
								ItemId=@ItemId ,
								ItemCode=@ItemCode,
								BarCode=@BarCode ,
								BatchCode=@BatchCode,
								ExpDate=@ExpDate ,
								Qty=@Qty,
								UnitId=@UnitId,
								pRate=@pRate ,
								sRate=@sRate ,
								MRP=@MRP ,
								Amt=@Amt ,
								TotalQty=@TotalQty ,
								TotalAmount=@TotalAmount ,
								TotalPackQtyWt=@TotalPackQtyWt ,
								TotalPack=@TotalPack ,
								TotalDenoQty=@TotalDenoQty ,
								BalQty=@BalQty ,
								Remark=@Remark ,
								BranchId=@BranchId ,
								ModifiedBy=@ModifiedBy ,
								ModifiedDateTime=SYSDATETIME(),
								FinancialYearId =@FinancialYearId ,
								[Status]=@Status where RePackProductid=@ProdID

								SELECT @Id= @ProdID

	end
else
	begin
		UPDATE tblBranch SET ReProdSrNo=isnull(ReProdSrNo,0)+1 where BranchId=@BranchId

		insert into tblRePackProduct(EntryNo ,EntryDate ,PackDate ,BarCode ,BatchCode ,ExpDate ,Qty ,ItemId ,ItemCode ,
		UnitId ,pRate ,sRate ,MRP ,Amt ,TotalQty ,TotalAmount ,TotalPackQtyWt,TotalPack,TotalDenoQty,BalQty,Remark ,
		BranchId ,CreatedBy ,CreatedDateTime,FinancialYearId ,[Status] )

		values(@EntryNo ,@EntryDate ,@PackDate ,@BarCode ,@BatchCode ,@ExpDate ,@Qty ,@ItemId ,
		@ItemCode ,@UnitId ,@pRate ,@sRate ,@MRP ,@Amt ,@TotalQty ,@TotalAmount ,@TotalPackQtyWt,@TotalPack,@TotalDenoQty,
		@BalQty ,@Remark ,@BranchId ,@CreatedBy ,SYSDATETIME(),@FinancialYearId ,@Status );

		if (@StockItem=1)
		Begin
			update [dbo].tblItem set QuantityOnHand = isnull(QuantityOnHand,0) - (@TotalQty) WHERE ItemId = @ItemId
		End 

		Set @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY()
		/*select @Id as Prodid*/
		
	end
	select @Id as RePackProductid
RETURN (select RePackProductid as RePackProductid from tblRePackProduct where RePackProductid=@ID)

END

GO

create Procedure [dbo].[prdinsertRePackProductDet] 
	@DetailID int,
	@PID int,
	@ItemId int,
	@BarCode varchar(50),
	@ItemCode varchar(50),
	@Unitid int,
	@pRate decimal,
	@sRate decimal,
	@MRP decimal,
	@PackQtyWt decimal,
	@Pack decimal,
	@DenoQty decimal,
	@Qty decimal,
	@iRate decimal,
	@Amt decimal,
	@CostPer decimal,
	@Margin decimal,
	@DenoUnit decimal,
	@Remark varchar(50),
	@CreatedBy int,
	@ModifiedBy int,
	@Status int,
	@BranchId int
As 
Begin
Declare @TranStatus int;

begin Transaction T
begin try

begin
DECLARE @StockItem INT

	set @StockItem=(SELECT StockItem AS StockItem FROM [dbo].tblItem WHERE [dbo].tblItem.ItemId =@ItemId)
	begin
		insert into tblRePackProductDet(pid,ItemId,BarCode,ItemCode,Unitid,pRate,sRate,MRP,PackQtyWt,Pack,DenoQty,Qty,iRate,Amt,CostPer,Margin,DenoUnit,Remark,CreatedBy,CreatedDateTime,Status,BranchId)
		values(@pid,@ItemId,@BarCode,@ItemCode,@Unitid,@pRate,@sRate,@MRP,@PackQtyWt,@Pack,@DenoQty,@Qty,@iRate,@Amt,@CostPer,@Margin,@DenoUnit,@Remark,@CreatedBy,SYSDATETIME(),@Status,@BranchId);
	end

	if (@StockItem=1)
	Begin
		update [dbo].tblItem set QuantityOnHand = QuantityOnHand + (@Qty) WHERE ItemId = @ItemId
	End 

end
	
end try
	begin catch
	set @TranStatus=0
	rollback Transaction T
	Select @TranStatus
	return
	end catch
commit transaction T
end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdInsertSalesMaster]
            @EType int, 
           @EntryNo NVARCHAR(50),
           @EntryDate SMALLDATETIME, 
           @LedgerId BIGINT, 
           @CustomerId BIGINT,
		   @CusName varchar(100),
           @SalesAddress NVARCHAR(50), 
           @PaymentMode INT, 
           @Telephone NVARCHAR(50),
           @Remarks NVARCHAR(50), 
           @TotalGross DECIMAL(18,2), 
           @TotalAmount DECIMAL(18,2), 
		   @AmountAdjust  DECIMAL(18,2),
           @TotalDiscount DECIMAL(18,2), 
           @TotalTax DECIMAL(18,2),
            @TotalCess DECIMAL(18,2), 
            @TotalIGST DECIMAL(18,2), 
            @TotalCGST DECIMAL(18,2),
             @TotalSGST DECIMAL(18,2),
			 @TotalVAT decimal(18,2),
              @DiscountPer DECIMAL(18,2), 
              @DiscountAmount DECIMAL(18,2), 
              @NetAmount DECIMAL(18,2), 
              @PaidAmount DECIMAL(18,2), 
              @BalanceAmount DECIMAL(18,2), 
              @EmployeeId BIGINT, 
              @TotalMiscCharges DECIMAL(18,2),  
              @ICardNo NVARCHAR(50), 
              @CreditDays int, 
              @DueDate DATE,
               @BranchId bigint, 
               @FinancialYearId bigint, 
               @TotalQuantity DECIMAL(18,3),  
               @TotalNetAmount DECIMAL(18,2), 
               @TotalSaveAmount DECIMAL(18,2), 
               @DeviceDescription NVARCHAR(50) , 
               @CreatedBy bigint,
			   @loypoints DECIMAL(18,2),
			   @redimvalue DECIMAL(18,2),
			   @loybalvalue DECIMAL(18,2),
			   @lck DECIMAL(18,2),
			   @OaAmount decimal(18,2),
			   @OaDesc varchar(max),
			   @OdAmount decimal(18,2),
			   @OdDesc varchar(max),
			   @Status int,
			   @mDevice varchar(100),
			   @mDeviceIP varchar(100),
			   @RcvAmnt decimal(18,2),
			   @BalAmnt decimal(18,2),
			   @EmailId varchar(100),
			   @Terms varchar(max),
			   @CardPrice decimal(18,2),
			   @NewCardCount int
                                     
AS
Declare @Id bigint; 

DECLARE @Serial TABLE( SalesSrlNo BIGINT )
	declare @currdate datetime
    /**set @currdate = convert(varchar, getdate(), 120)*/
	set @currdate = getdate()

begin try
 begin transaction

BEGIN 
UPDATE tblLocationDetails SET SalesSrlNo=SalesSrlNo+1 
OUTPUT inserted.SalesSrlNo INTO @Serial 
where LocId =@BranchId
 END
 begin

INSERT INTO tblSalesMaster(EType,EntryNo,EntryDate,LedgerId,CustomerId,CusName,SalesAddress,
PaymentMode,Telephone, Remarks,TotalGross, TotalAmount,AmountAdjust,TotalDiscount,TotalTax,TotalCess,TotalIGST,TotalCGST, 
TotalSGST,DiscountPer,DiscountAmount,NetAmount,PaidAmount,BalanceAmount,EmployeeId,TotalMiscCharges,
ICardNo,CreditDays,DueDate,BranchId,FinancialYearId,TotalQuantity,TotalNetAmount,TotalSaveAmount,
DeviceDescription,CreatedBy,CreatedDateTime,loypoints,redimvalue,loybalvalue,lck,OaAmount ,OaDesc ,OdAmount ,
OdDesc,Status,mDevice,mDeviceIP,RcvAmnt,BalAmnt,Email,Terms,CardPrice,TotalVAT,NewCardCount)
VALUES(@EType ,@EntryNo,@EntryDate ,@LedgerId ,@CustomerId ,@CusName,@SalesAddress ,@PaymentMode ,
@Telephone ,@Remarks ,@TotalGross ,@TotalAmount ,@AmountAdjust,@TotalDiscount ,@TotalTax ,
@TotalCess ,@TotalIGST ,@TotalCGST ,@TotalSGST ,@DiscountPer ,@DiscountAmount ,@NetAmount ,
@PaidAmount ,@BalanceAmount ,@EmployeeId ,@TotalMiscCharges ,@ICardNo ,@CreditDays ,@DueDate ,
@BranchId ,@FinancialYearId ,@TotalQuantity ,@TotalNetAmount ,@TotalSaveAmount ,@DeviceDescription ,
@CreatedBy,@currdate ,@loypoints,@redimvalue,@loybalvalue,@lck,@OaAmount,@OaDesc ,@OdAmount ,
@OdDesc,@Status,@mDevice,@mDeviceIP,@RcvAmnt,@BalAmnt,@EmailId,@Terms,@CardPrice,@TotalVAT,@NewCardCount) 
Set @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY()
--select @Id as SalesMasterId
select SalesMasterId,EntryNo from tblSalesMaster where SalesMasterId=@Id
END

end try
begin catch
rollback
end catch

@CessAmount decimal(18,2),

@FinancialYearId bigint,

@TotalSaveAmount decimal(18,2),
@MRP decimal(18,2),
@QuantitytoSubtract bigint,
@StockItem bigint,
@CreatedBy bigint,
@VatAmount decimal(18,2),
@ProductType int,
@ReturnReson int,

AS

    /**set @currdate = convert(varchar, getdate(), 120)*/
	set @currdate = getdate()

BEGIN   
INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblSalesReturnDetails]
        ([SalesReturnMasterId]
        ,[ItemId]
        ,[ItemCode]
        ,[ItemBarCode]
        ,[UnitId]
        ,[Quantity]
        ,[FreeQuantity]
        ,[SalesRate]
		,[IRate]
        ,[Amount]
        ,[DiscountPer]
        ,[DiscountAmount]
        ,[IGSTAmount]
        ,[CGSTAmount]
        ,[SGSTAmount]
        ,[GrossAmount]
		,TaxPer
        ,[TaxAmount]
        ,[NetAmount]
		,CessPer
		,CessAmount
        ,[BranchId]
        ,[FinancialYearId]
        ,[TaxType]
        ,[Isrno]
        ,[TotalSaveAmount]
        ,[MRP]
        ,[CreatedBy]
		,[CreatedDateTime]
		,[VatAmount]
		,[ProductType]
		,[Tax]
        )
     VALUES
       (@SalesReturnMasterId
        ,@ItemId
        ,@ItemCode
        ,@ItemBarCode
        ,@UnitId
        ,@Quantity
        ,@FreeQuantity
        ,@SalesRate
		,@IRate
        ,@Amount
        ,@DiscountPer
        ,@DiscountAmount
        ,@IGSTAmount
        ,@CGSTAmount
        ,@SGSTAmount
        ,@GrossAmount
		,@TaxPer
        ,@TaxAmount
        ,@NetAmount
		,@CessPer
		,@CessAmount
        ,@BranchId
        ,@FinancialYearId
        ,@TaxType
        ,@Isrno
        ,@TotalSaveAmount
        ,@MRP
        ,@CreatedBy,@currdate,@VatAmount,@ProductType,@Tax)

	--	update [dbo].tblItem set QuantityOnHand = QuantityOnHand - @Quantity WHERE ItemId = @ItemId
	if(@ProductType=6)
	begin
	if(@ReturnReson=2)
		begin
			insert into tblRedemptionDamagedProducts(ProductId,BarCode,SuggestedPrice,CreatedBY,CreatedOn,Qty,Status,BranchId,Description)
											  values(@ItemId,@ItemBarCode,@SalesRate,@CreatedBy,SYSDATETIME(),@Quantity,1,@BranchId,@ItemCode)
		end
	else
	begin
	update tblProductRate set QOH=QOH+@Quantity where Id=@prid 
	end
	end

	if (@StockItem=1)
	Begin
	update [dbo].tblItem set QuantityOnHand = QuantityOnHand + (@QuantitytoSubtract*@Quantity) WHERE ItemId = @ItemId
	End 

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdInsertThirdpartyTransfer]

END

	end
	SELECT @vid  as Id
END

@LedgerId int,
@ICardNo varchar(100),
@Balance decimal(18,2),
@Recharge decimal(18,2),
@CurrentBalance decimal(18,2),
@gNotes varchar(100),
@payid int,
@mDevice varchar(100),
@mDeviceIP varchar(100),
@Status int,
@BranchId int,
@CreatedBy int,
@Etype int,
@Debit decimal(18,2),
@MasterId int,
@EstOutTime datetime,
@Rating int,
@Duration int,
@Tax varchar(50),
@TaxSettingsId int,
@TaxAmt decimal(18,2),
@CardBalance decimal(18,2),
@CashBonusBalance decimal(18,2),
@TokenBalance decimal(18,2),
@PointBalance decimal(18,2),
@GamePayType int,

@Offer decimal(18,2),
@HappyHoure decimal(18,2),
@Bonus decimal(18,2),
@Discount decimal(10,2),
@Point decimal(18,2),
@CompReson int,
@Token decimal(18,2),
@TaxPer decimal(18,2),
@TaxType varchar(50),
@RcvAmt decimal(18,2),
@BalAmt decimal(18,2),
@CardPrice decimal(18,2),
@NetAmt decimal(18,2),

@LedgerName VARCHAR(100),
@Mobile varchar(50),
@Email varchar(100),
@Address varchar(max)
AS
Declare @Val varchar(50);
BEGIN
if (@LedgerId=0)
begin
    set @Val= (Select MAX(CAST(LedgerCode AS bigint)) AS LedgerCode from tblAccountLedger);
	insert into tblAccountLedger(LedgerCode,LedgerName,Mobile,EmailId,LedgerAddress,CardBalance,CashBonusBalance,TokenBalance,PointBalance,ICardNo,Status,Remarks,CreatedBy,CreatedDateTime,EnrollDate,BranchId)
	values(@Val+1,@LedgerName,@Mobile,@Email,@Address,@CardBalance,@CashBonusBalance,@TokenBalance,@PointBalance,@ICardNo,@Status,@gNotes,@CreatedBy,SYSDATETIME(),SYSDATETIME(),@BranchId)
	set @LedgerId=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
end
else
begin
	update tblAccountLedger set CardBalance=@CardBalance,CashBonusBalance=@CashBonusBalance,TokenBalance=@TokenBalance,PointBalance=@PointBalance,ModifiedBy=@CreatedBy,ModifiedDateTime=SYSDATETIME() where LedgerId=@LedgerId;
end

insert into tblCardHistory(EntryDate,Etype,LedgerId,ICardNo,Balance,Amount,CurrentBalance,gNotes,payid,mDevice,mDeviceIP,Status,BranchId,CreatedBy,CreatedDateTime,Debit,MasterId,EstOutTime,Rating,Duration,Tax,TaxSettingsId,TaxAmt,GamePayType,
Offer,HappyHoure,Bonus,Discount,Point,CompReson,Token,TaxType,TaxPer,RcvAmt,BalAmt,CardPrice,NetAmt)
values( getdate(),@Etype,@LedgerId,@ICardNo,@Balance,@Recharge,@CurrentBalance,@gNotes,@payid,@mDevice,@mDeviceIP,@Status,@BranchId,@CreatedBy,SYSDATETIME(),@Debit,@MasterId,@EstOutTime,@Rating,@Duration,@Tax,@TaxSettingsId,@TaxAmt,@GamePayType,
@Offer,@HappyHoure,@Bonus,@Discount,@Point,@CompReson,@Token,@TaxType,@TaxPer,@RcvAmt,@BalAmt,@CardPrice,@NetAmt);
Select SCOPE_IDENTITY() as Id Return;

update tblGame set Rating=(select avg(rating) as rate from tblCardHistory where MasterId=@MasterId and Etype=0) where ID=@MasterId;;

END
GO

create procedure [dbo].[prdTest]
@Id bigint
as
begin
Declare @Status int;
begin Transaction T

begin Try
select * from tblTest where Id=@Id
Set @Status=1;
end Try

begin catch
Set @Status=0;
Select @Status
rollback Transaction T
return;
end catch

commit Transaction T
Select @Status
return;

end

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[prdUpdate_AutoStk_Opstk]    Script Date: 12-08-2023 17:26:38 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdUpdate_AutoStk_Opstk]
@from_Date date ,
@to_Date date ,
@BranchId int,
@ModifiedBy int
AS

	declare @currdate datetime
    /**set @currdate = convert(varchar, getdate(), 120)*/
	set @currdate = getdate()

	DECLARE @Tpur decimal(18,3),@TSal decimal(18,3),@TSalR decimal(18,3),@TPurR decimal(18,3),@TOut decimal(18,3),@TInw decimal(18,3)
	DECLARE @Cur_ItemId INT,@Cur_Stk decimal(18,3),@QOH_Stk decimal(18,3)

	DECLARE Opstk_Cursor CURSOR FOR 
	SELECT a1.ItemId, a1.Stk AS Stk
	FROM dbo.tblOpStk a1
	WHERE a1.EntryDate=@from_Date and 
	id=(select max(id) from dbo.tblOpStk  a2 where a2.EntryDate=@from_Date and a2.ItemId=a1.ItemId)
	and	a1.BranchId=@BranchId
	order by a1.ItemId


	OPEN Opstk_Cursor 
	FETCH NEXT FROM Opstk_Cursor INTO
		@Cur_ItemId, @Cur_Stk
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
		set @Tpur=0
		set @TSal=0
		set @TSalR=0
		set @TPurR=0
		set @TInw=0
		set @TOut=0
		set @QOH_Stk=0
			/*SET @MessageOutput = convert(varchar,@id)+' '+ @uname*/
			/* Tot Purchase*/
			set @Tpur=(SELECT isnull(Sum(dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.Quantity),0) AS TPQty
						FROM dbo.tblPurchaseMaster INNER JOIN dbo.tblPurchaseDetails ON dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.PurchaseMasterId = dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.PurchaseMasterId
						WHERE dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.EntryDate between @from_Date AND @to_Date and dbo.tblPurchaseMaster.BranchId=@BranchId AND dbo.tblPurchaseDetails.ItemId=@Cur_ItemId)
			/* Tot Purchase*/

			/* Tot sale*/
			set @TSal=(SELECT isnull(Sum(dbo.tblSalesDetails.Quantity),0) AS TSQty
						FROM dbo.tblSalesMaster INNER JOIN dbo.tblSalesDetails ON dbo.tblSalesMaster.SalesMasterId = dbo.tblSalesDetails.SalesMasterId
						WHERE dbo.tblSalesMaster.EntryDate between @from_Date AND @to_Date and dbo.tblSalesMaster.BranchId=@BranchId AND dbo.tblSalesDetails.ItemId=@Cur_ItemId)
			/* Tot sale*/
			
			/* Tot sale return*/
			set @TSalR=(SELECT isnull(Sum(dbo.tblSalesReturnDetails.Quantity),0) AS TSRQty
						FROM dbo.tblSalesReturnMaster INNER JOIN dbo.tblSalesReturnDetails ON dbo.tblSalesReturnMaster.SalesReturnMasterId= dbo.tblSalesReturnDetails.SalesReturnMasterId
						WHERE dbo.tblSalesReturnMaster.EntryDate between @from_Date AND @to_Date and dbo.tblSalesReturnMaster.BranchId=@BranchId AND dbo.tblSalesReturnDetails.ItemId=@Cur_ItemId)			
			/* Tot sale return*/

			/* Tot Purchase return*/
			set @TPurR=(SELECT isnull(Sum(dbo.tblPurchaseReturnDetails.Quantity),0) AS TPRQty
						FROM dbo.tblPurchaseReturnMaster INNER JOIN dbo.tblPurchaseReturnDetails ON dbo.tblPurchaseReturnMaster.PurchaseReturnMasterId= dbo.tblPurchaseReturnDetails.PurchaseReturnMasterId
						WHERE dbo.tblPurchaseReturnMaster.EntryDate between @from_Date AND @to_Date and dbo.tblPurchaseReturnMaster.BranchId=@BranchId AND dbo.tblPurchaseReturnDetails.ItemId=@Cur_ItemId)			
			/* Tot Purchase return*/

			/* Tot Inward*/
			set @TInw=(SELECT isnull(Sum(dbo.tblInwDetails.Quantity),0) AS TInwQty
						FROM dbo.tblInward INNER JOIN dbo.tblInwDetails ON dbo.tblInward.InwardMasterId= dbo.tblInwDetails.InwardMasterId
						WHERE dbo.tblInward.EntryDate between @from_Date AND @to_Date and dbo.tblInward.BranchId=@BranchId AND dbo.tblInwDetails.ItemId=@Cur_ItemId)			
			/* Tot Inward*/

			/* Tot Outward*/
			set @TOut=(SELECT isnull(Sum(dbo.tblOutwardDetails.Quantity),0) AS TOutQty
						FROM dbo.tblOutward INNER JOIN dbo.tblOutwardDetails ON dbo.tblOutward.OutwardId= dbo.tblOutwardDetails.OutwardId
						WHERE dbo.tblOutward.EntryDate between @from_Date AND @to_Date and dbo.tblOutward.BranchId=@BranchId AND dbo.tblOutwardDetails.ItemId=@Cur_ItemId)			
			/* Tot Outward*/

			set @QOH_Stk=(@Cur_Stk+@Tpur+@TSalR+@TInw)-(@TSal+@TPurR+@TOut)
			update  tblItem set LastQOH=[QuantityOnHand] ,ModifiedBy=@ModifiedBy,ModifiedDateTime=getdate(),OpStkDate=@from_Date WHERE BranchId=@BranchId and ItemId=@Cur_ItemId
			update  tblItem set [QuantityOnHand]=@QOH_Stk ,ModifiedBy=@ModifiedBy,ModifiedDateTime=getdate(),OpStkDate=@from_Date WHERE BranchId=@BranchId and ItemId=@Cur_ItemId

		    /*RAISERROR(@MessageOutput,0,1) WITH NOWAIT*/
			/*RAISERROR(@QOH_Stk,0,1) WITH NOWAIT*/
		    FETCH NEXT FROM Opstk_Cursor INTO
			@Cur_ItemId, @Cur_Stk
		END

CLOSE Opstk_Cursor
DEALLOCATE Opstk_Cursor



GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdUpdate_CurrentLoyal]
@id int

AS
BEGIN
Declare @v as int;
Declare @cusid as int;
set @v=(select (NetAmount/10)  from tblSalesMaster where SalesMasterId=@id);
set @cusid=(select CustomerId from tblSalesMaster where SalesMasterId=@id);
update tblAccountLedger set loypoints=loypoints+@v where LedgerId=@cusid;
END

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[prdUpdateCard]
@CardId int,
@SuggestedPrice decimal(10,2),
@Qoh int,
@Tax nvarchar(50),
@TaxSettingsId decimal(10,2),
@TaxTypeId decimal(10,2),
@ModifiedBy int,
@Status int,
@BranchId int
As
Declare @Id bigint;


Begin

if @CardId=0
begin
	insert into tblCard(QOH,SRate,TaxTypeId,TaxSettingsId,Tax,CreatedBy,CreatedOn,Status,LocationId)
				values(@Qoh,@SuggestedPrice,@TaxTypeId,@TaxSettingsId,@Tax,@ModifiedBy,SYSDATETIME(),1,@BranchId)
end
else
	begin
		Update tblCard set QOH=@Qoh,SRate=@SuggestedPrice,TaxTypeId=@TaxTypeId,TaxSettingsId=@TaxSettingsId,Tax=@Tax,
		@ModifiedBy=@ModifiedBy,ModifiedOn=SYSDATETIME(),Status=1 where CardId=@CardId
		SET @Id= @CardId
	end
	SELECT @ID  as CardId
RETURN 

End
GO

As

,ModifiedDateTime=getdate() where  FinancialYearId=@FinancialYearId

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[prdUpdateItemFromPurchaseGrid]    Script Date: 12-08-2023 17:26:38 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE procedure [dbo].[prdUpdateItemFromPurchaseGrid]
@ItemId bigint,
@UnitId bigint,
@FieldName nvarchar(50),
@FieldValue decimal(18,2),
@ModifiedBy bigint
AS
BEGIN
if(@FieldName='PurchaseRate')
begin

update tblItem set ModifiedBy=@ModifiedBy,ModifiedDateTime=GETDATE(),
LastPurchaseRate1 = (CASE WHEN MainUnitId=@UnitId THEN @FieldValue else LastPurchaseRate1 END),
LastPurchaseRate2=(CASE WHEN SubUnitId=@UnitId THEN @FieldValue  else LastPurchaseRate2 END),
PurchaseRate1 = (CASE WHEN MainUnitId=@UnitId THEN @FieldValue else PurchaseRate1 END),
PurchaseRate2=(CASE WHEN SubUnitId=@UnitId THEN @FieldValue  else PurchaseRate2 END)
WHERE ItemId=@ItemId

end

if(@FieldName='SellingPer')
begin

update tblItem set  ModifiedBy=@ModifiedBy,ModifiedDateTime=GETDATE(),LastSellingPer = SellingPer, SellingPer = @FieldValue
 WHERE ItemId = @ItemId

end
if(@FieldName='MRP')
begin

update tblItem set  ModifiedBy=@ModifiedBy,ModifiedDateTime=GETDATE(),
LastMRP1 = (CASE WHEN MainUnitId = @UnitId THEN @FieldValue else LastMRP1 END),
LastMRP2 = (CASE WHEN SubUnitId = @UnitId THEN @FieldValue else LastMRP2 END),
MRP1 = (CASE WHEN MainUnitId = @UnitId THEN @FieldValue else MRP1 END),
MRP2 = (CASE WHEN SubUnitId = @UnitId THEN @FieldValue else MRP2 END)
WHERE ItemId=@ItemId

end

if(@FieldName='SaleRate')
begin

update tblItem set  ModifiedBy=@ModifiedBy,ModifiedDateTime=GETDATE(),
LastSaleRate = (CASE WHEN MainUnitId = @UnitId THEN @FieldValue else LastSaleRate END),
LastSubSaleRate = (CASE WHEN SubUnitId = @UnitId THEN @FieldValue else LastSubSaleRate END),
SaleRate = (CASE WHEN MainUnitId = @UnitId THEN @FieldValue else SaleRate END),
SubSaleRate = (CASE WHEN SubUnitId = @UnitId THEN @FieldValue else SubSaleRate END)

WHERE ItemId=@ItemId

end



if(@FieldName='IGSTPer')
begin

update tblItem set  ModifiedBy=@ModifiedBy,ModifiedDateTime=GETDATE(),
IGSTPer = @FieldValue 
WHERE ItemId=@ItemId

end

if(@FieldName='SGSTPer')
begin

update tblItem set  ModifiedBy=@ModifiedBy,ModifiedDateTime=GETDATE(),
SGSTPer= @FieldValue 
WHERE ItemId=@ItemId

end


if(@FieldName='CGSTPer')
begin

update tblItem set  ModifiedBy=@ModifiedBy,ModifiedDateTime=GETDATE(),
CGSTPer= @FieldValue 
WHERE ItemId=@ItemId

end

if(@FieldName='TaxType')
begin

update tblItem set  ModifiedBy=@ModifiedBy,ModifiedDateTime=GETDATE(),
TaxType= @FieldValue 
WHERE ItemId=@ItemId

end

END
GO

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[prdUpdateQoh] 
@PurchaseDetailId bigint,
@ItemId bigint,
@QuantitytoSubtract bigint
As Begin
update [dbo].tblItem set QuantityOnHand = QuantityOnHand - 
((select Quantity from tblPurchaseDetails WHERE PurchaseDetailId=@PurchaseDetailId and ItemId=@ItemId) * @QuantitytoSubtract)
WHERE ItemId = @ItemId;
End

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[prdUpdateSalesReturnMaster]

		   @SalesReturnMasterId bigint,
          @EType int, 
           @EntryNo NVARCHAR(50),
           @EntryDate SMALLDATETIME, 
           @LedgerId BIGINT, 
           @CustomerId BIGINT, 
           @SalesAddress NVARCHAR(50), 
           @PaymentMode INT, 
           @Telephone NVARCHAR(50),
            @Remarks NVARCHAR(50), 
           @TotalGross DECIMAL(18,2), 
           @TotalAmount DECIMAL(18,2), 
           @TotalDiscount DECIMAL(18,2), 
           @TotalTax DECIMAL(18,2),
            @TotalCess DECIMAL(18,2), 
            @TotalIGST DECIMAL(18,2), 
            @TotalCGST DECIMAL(18,2),
             @TotalSGST DECIMAL(18,2),
              @DiscountPer DECIMAL(18,2), 
              @DiscountAmount DECIMAL(18,2), 
			  @AmountAdjust DECIMAL(18,2),
              @NetAmount DECIMAL(18,2), 
              @PaidAmount DECIMAL(18,2), 
              @BalanceAmount DECIMAL(18,2), 
              @EmployeeId BIGINT, 
              @TotalMiscCharges DECIMAL(18,2),  
              @ICardNo NVARCHAR(50), 
              @CreditDays int, 
              @DueDate DATE,
               @BranchId bigint, 
               @FinancialYearId bigint, 
               @TotalQuantity bigint, 
               @TotalNetAmount DECIMAL(18,2), 
               @TotalSaveAmount DECIMAL(18,2), 
               @DeviceDescription nvarchar(50), 
           @ModifiedBy bigint
		  
          

AS
BEGIN

UPDATE [tblSalesReturnMaster]
   SET [EType] = @EType,
		[EntryNo] = @EntryNo,--no need to update this
		[EntryDate] = @EntryDate,		
		[LedgerId] = @LedgerId,
		CustomerId=@CustomerId,
		[SalesAddress] = @SalesAddress,
		[PaymentMode] = @PaymentMode,
		[Telephone] = @Telephone,
		[Remarks] = @Remarks,
		[TotalGross] = @TotalGross,
		[TotalAmount] = @TotalAmount,
		[TotalDiscount] = @TotalDiscount,
		AmountAdjust=@AmountAdjust,
		TotalTax=@TotalTax,
		TotalCess=@TotalCess,
		[TotalIGST] = @TotalIGST,
		[TotalCGST] = @TotalCGST,
		[TotalSGST] = @TotalSGST,		
		[DiscountPer] = @DiscountPer,
		[DiscountAmount] = @DiscountAmount,		
		[NetAmount] = @NetAmount,
		[PaidAmount] = @PaidAmount,
		[BalanceAmount] = @BalanceAmount,
		[EmployeeId] = @EmployeeId,
		TotalMiscCharges = @TotalMiscCharges,
		[ICardNo] = @ICardNo,
		[CreditDays] = @CreditDays,
		[DueDate] = @DueDate,
		[BranchId] = @BranchId,
		[FinancialYearId] = @FinancialYearId,
		[TotalQuantity] = @TotalQuantity,
		[TotalNetAmount] = @TotalNetAmount,
		[TotalSaveAmount] = @TotalSaveAmount,

 WHERE [SalesReturnMasterId] = @SalesReturnMasterId

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[prdUpdateUserLoginOutDateTime]

@UserAccountId bigint,
@LoginStatus bigint,
@LogSysName varchar(50)
AS
Begin

if @LoginStatus=1
	Update tblUserAccount set LastLoginDate=SYSDATETIME(),lastlogsystem=@LogSysName,LoginStatus=1 where UserAccountId=@UserAccountId
else
	Update tblUserAccount set LastLogOutDate=SYSDATETIME(),LoginStatus=0 where UserAccountId=@UserAccountId
End

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[prdVoidSaleRechargeDetails]    Script Date: 12-08-2023 17:26:38 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE procedure [dbo].[prdVoidSaleRechargeDetails]
@SId int,
@HId int,
@CardNo nvarchar(50),
@InvoiceNo nvarchar(50),
@BranchId bigint,
@CreatedBy bigint,
@ModifiedBy bigint,
@Status bigint,
@flagexist int,
@producttype int,
@productid bigint,
@Prid int

AS
Declare @regamount bigint;
Declare @CountRows bigint;
BEGIN
set @regamount= (select amount from tblCardHistory where Id=@HId)
set @CountRows= (SELECT COUNT(*) AS CountRows FROM tblVoidSale WHERE SalesMasterId =@SId )

BEGIN 
	IF (@HId != 0) or ( @SId ! = 0 and @CountRows = 0  )
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO tblVoidSale (CardHistoryId,SalesMasterId,ICardNo,InvoiceNo,BranchId,CreatedBy,CreatedDateTime,Status)
VALUES (@HId,@SId,@CardNo,@InvoiceNo,@BranchId,@CreatedBy,SYSDATETIME(),@Status);
		END


update tblSalesMaster set Status=0 where SalesMasterId=@SId;
update tblSalesDetails set Status=0 where SalesMasterId=@SId;
update tblCardHistory set Status=0 where Id=@HId;

END


if @producttype = 2 or @producttype = 4 or @producttype = 5 or @producttype = 7
begin
		if  @flagexist = 0 
			begin
				update tblAccountLedger set Status=0 where ICardNo=@CardNo
				update tblCard set QOH = QOH + 1 where LocationId = @BranchId
			END
		else	
			begin		
				update tblAccountLedger set CardBalance=CardBalance-@regamount where ICardNo=@CardNo
			END
END
else
	begin	
			update tblProductRate set QOH = QOH + 1 where  Id=@Prid 		
	end
END


GO

CREATE procedure [dbo].[SP_InsertData]	
(
@EmpId int,
@FirstName varchar(50),
@LastName varchar(50),
--@Dob date,
@Age int,
@UserName varchar(50),
@Password varchar(50),
@ConfirmPassword varchar(50),
@Email varchar(50),
@mobile int
)
as 
begin

insert into tbl_UsrRegistration(EmpId,FirstName,LastName,Age,UserName,Password,ConfirmPassword,Email,mobile)
values(@EmpId,@FirstName,@LastName,@Age,@UserName,@Password,@ConfirmPassword,@Email,@mobile)
end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Upd_ButtonCreations] 
@BId int,

@BgImage nvarchar(50),
@FontNames nvarchar(50)
As
Declare @Id bigint;

Begin

	begin
		update tblButtonCreations set 
		ModifiedOn=SYSDATETIME(),FontNames=@FontNames,BgImage=@BgImage,

	end
END
